news_mentions.headline: Aaron Glenn says improving Jets 'only thing I think about' amid 2-6 start
news_mentions.description: Head coach Aaron Glenn says improving the Jets is "the only thing I think about" amid the team's 2-6 start to the season.
news_mentions.body_text: new york jets head coach aaron glenn faced questions monday about whether he s concerned about his job security one day after the team fell to 2 6 the jets blew a nine point second half lead at home on sunday falling 38 33 to the rebuilding las vegas raiders it marked gang green s third straight loss and their second three game losing streak of the season with so much to clean up glenn said he doesn t have time to consider whether his job is in jeopardy there s so much that i think about when it comes to us improving each week that it doesn t really come across my mind to be honest with you glenn told reporters on monday i understand how this league is i understand about what this business is about but my first job each week is improving this team and that s the only thing that i think about glenn s message continues to focus on what s in front of the jets absolutely i mean that s what this is glenn said it s a bottom line business and we have to win but we still have nine games left so we still have an opportunity to win nine games glenn s defense collapsed on sunday allowing kirk cousins to light it up through the air cousins became the sixth qb since 1950 age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes and a rushing touchdown in a game joining tom brady five times hall of famer drew brees three times vinny testaverde josh mccown and jon kitna per nfl research the jets offense put up enough points to defeat the raiders even if two stalled red zone drives early stung glenn s defense was the culprit we were not successful in the passing game glenn said a lot of that has to do with us number one making plays two me putting them in position and three not allowing these third down penalties the jets imported a slew of veteran defenders to help fix the defense this offseason it hasn t worked so far and if glenn s defense continues to deteriorate things could get even uglier i m disappointed to be here at 2 6 no doubt receiver garrett wilson said per the new york daily news that s not the goal at the end of the day i take a lot of pride in it each week in improving the record but just playing good football for the jets name for the wilson name so it s deep nothing changes we are trying to go 9 0 to finish whatever it may be a 9 0 finish or something close might be what s needed for glenn to change the storyline when it comes to his future

news_mentions.headline: Jeffery Simmons makes 'profound' impact in first game with Bears
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears' acquisition of Jeffery Simmons immediately paid off with the defensive tackle spearheading a crew that destroyed the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: how s that for immediate impact the chicago bears trade for defensive tackle jeffery simmons paid instant dividends in monday night s 34 17 road shellacking of the defending super bowl champion seattle seahawks his impact was profound coach ben johnson said of simmons per the team s official website the man sporting the bright orange long sleeves was impossible to miss simmons stuffed the stat sheet in his first game with the bears netting a sack six tackles two tackles for loss a pass defended and a quarterback pressure we re always watching the jumbotron but we were really watching the jumbotron receiver kalif raymond quipped watching him play watching the impact he has i mean he has a whole other element simmons arrival allows coordinator dennis allen to play his defense differently instead of blitzing additional rushers to get one on one matchups the new addition does that for him simmons was the only bears defensive lineman to record double digit double teams 13 on monday night per next gen stats that presence opened up the rest of the crew it s not a coincidence that montez sweat had his best game with his former mississippi state teammate in the lineup sweat had a sack three qb pressures and a tackle for loss in the win i definitely got my opportunities sweat said i definitely got some 1 on 1s i was looking forward to taking advantage of that and i m looking forward to doing that the rest of the year simmons has definitely upped his game and his iq he s always had a real love for the game and that affects you across the whole line and the whole team despite just arriving simmons played a full slate of snaps 48 of 56 per ngs when the big man was on the field chicago allowed just 3 0 yards per play on a 25 0 success rate while recording five tackles for loss on the eight plays simmons was off the field the bears allowed 13 3 yards per play a 62 5 success rate and a 37 5 explosive play rate that s a quantitative difference i kept telling myself it s just football go out there and be me play by play just stay in the moment simmons said that s always my goal just embrace the moment that s what happened tonight it was like a lift off my shoulders once i ran out there thank god they got the ball first as well to be able to run out there and get my first snaps as a chicago bear it was a lot of emotions i m grateful to be here and today was a great start if simmons play keeps up the hefty cost to acquire him won t seem so weighty down the road simmons has been a game wrecker for years unfortunately too few people got to see that in action over the past seven plus seasons in tennessee in chicago the man in neon orange will be hard to miss

news_mentions.headline: Bears-Seahawks on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Chicago's 34-17 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down Chicago's win on Monday night over the reigning Super Bowl champion, Seattle.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago makes another statement as contenders the bears beat the reigning afc champion last week at home as an encore they went ahead and took down the reigning super bowl champions on the road at lumen field one of the most formidable stadiums in the league for visiting teams the latter victory was perhaps their most impressive of the season chicago led wire to wire immediately quieting seattle s home crowd by forcing a three and out and following it up with an 80 yard touchdown march that took 17 plays the most against seattle on a td drive in 10 years per nfl research caleb williams threw for 247 yards against a defense that had been allowing 144 4 passing yards per game with no previous signal caller going over 176 yards the bears offense put up 363 yards total another high allowed by the seahawks who are one of three teams in the past 20 seasons to allow 301 or fewer yards in each of their first seven games chicago s defense was swarming sacking sam darnold three times picking him off once and holding seattle to 252 total yards only 1 more than the seahawks season low and the special teams that unit blocked a critical field goal in the first minute of the fourth quarter when the game was still close the bears set the tone early responded when necessary and outlasted the champs for what turned out to be a comfortable margin of victory who would deny them as contenders at this point seahawks aren t playing complementary football seattle s defense fought about as courageously as a unit could while giving up 34 points for much of the night as the seahawks offense floundered the defense kept them in it holding the bears to six points over their last five first half possessions after the odyssey that was chicago s opening td drive the defense also forced a three and out right after halftime which the offense rudely paid back with its fourth three and out of the game in the end the dark side d wore down at fault for the points allowed but hardly the reason the seahawks lost sam darnold and co were completely outmatched they went one of 11 on third down a symptom of offensive coordinator brian fleury s confounding plan to run or throw short on early downs despite it constantly resulting in playing behind the sticks darnold looked jumpy throughout while completing only half of his passes going 17 of 34 for 188 yards two touchdowns and an interception and the run game continually ran into a brick wall the seahawks are now 1 2 in their last three games during which they ve averaged 12 3 points per game while giving up a respectable 22 7 points per game they went 1 2 in their three games before that as well although during that stretch it was the defense that momentarily lost its way from week 3 5 the seahawks averaged 30 points per game but allowed 29 3 per outing the unevenness has resulted in a 4 4 record tied with the rams in the middle of the nfc west and only one game ahead of the cellar dwelling cardinals the two sides must find their stride simultaneously moving forward to have any hope of sustaining a winning streak simmons effect the immediacy with which jeffery simmons made an impact on monday night s game was impressive traded from a one win team to the reigning nfc north champions on thursday and three days later playing his first prime time game in three years the perennial pro bowler put on a menacing performance from the start his most showy display of dominance came on his fourth snap as a bear simmons swam past grey zabel with ease burst into the backfield and flung sam darnold to the ground for a sack with ferocity it was a massive play unfortunately minimized by grady jarrett committing a face mask penalty after the whistle but it still provided an early sign of what could be for the bears who finally have a difference maker on the interior and stayed charged up to force a punt three plays later anyway simmons logged three tackles a qb pressure and the sack in his first 10 snaps and by game s end had a team leading six tackles a sack a qb hit a pass deflection and two tackles for loss chicago s defense had been playing well this year ranking ninth in both points and yards allowed entering week 8 but the unit rendered seattle hopeless for large swaths of monday night instead of being overwhelmed by the 12s on the road the bears d instead fed off its own contagious atmosphere it s all thanks to the man in the orange sleeves an alteration from the red he rocked with the titans for all those years prior jsn and who else you would think the returns of zach charbonnet and jadarian price plus the addition of guard quenton nelson would provide a big boost to seattle s running game sadly for the seahawks that was far from the case price managed a meager 29 yards on 10 carries while charbonnet had six carries for 23 yards seattle s 81 rushing yards were its second lowest on the season and even reaching that total seemed an arduous task with the bears regularly taking away would be lanes and the running backs too often opting to bail out to try to find space laterally when it came to passing jaxon smith njigba was essentially the entire operation he accounted for 92 of the team s 94 passing yards by halftime with four catches to the rest of the team s three he made tyrique stevenson look downright foolish on his second quarter touchdown leaving the safety in the dust by faking in for a slant before cutting upfield and streaking down the sideline all alone but when the bears finally silenced him over the next two quarters seattle s already quiet supporting cast didn t get any louder tory horton finished with three catches for 26 yards aj barner contributed 23 yards on two snags price charbonnet and cooper kupp each failed to hit double digits in receiving yards and they combined for six catches smith njigba is an all world receiver but where in the world is the other production coming from in this offense williams spreads the wealth just as they did last week the bears opened up with a heightened focus on luther burden the second year wideout collected four catches for 23 yards and a touchdown on chicago s opening drive he led the team in receptions six and yards 53 at halftime and again just like last week he hardly contributed to the stat sheet in the second half adding only one more catch for 3 yards while rome odunze began heating up to end with 87 yards on four catches colston loveland who tied burden for the team lead with nine targets catching seven of them for 65 yards enjoyed the most balanced game in terms of catching williams eye he did fumble however gifting the seahawks a short field to eventually make it a three point game in the final frame yet another playmaker showed up as part of chicago s response to the gaffe after a delay of game penalty fortuitously saved the bears from having a run blown up on third and 4 kalif raymond took his turn catching a backward pass from williams on the ensuing third and 9 and splitting a crowd of seahawks to take the 39 yard run down to seattle s 5 d 39 andre swift who averaged only 2 6 yards per carry on 27 attempts punched it in from there his second of a hat trick of rushing touchdowns on the night the bears offense is the complete opposite of seattle s jsn centric attack everyone can do damage it s impossible to predict who is going to hurt you and that s what makes it so dangerous next gen stats insight for bears seahawks via nfl pro caleb williams completed 10 of his 15 play action pass attempts 66 7 for 109 yards and one touchdown against the seahawks his 47 2 play action rate is his highest this season and the fourth highest by a quarterback this season minimum 25 attempts nfl research the bears became the first team in nfl history to beat both super bowl participants from the previous season in back to back prime time games

news_mentions.headline: Matt LaFleur says Packers anticipate keeping RB Josh Jacobs on roster
news_mentions.description: Green Bay coach Matt LaFleur says the Packers plan to keep Josh Jacobs on their roster following the news of previous allegations against the running back.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay wis green bay coach matt lafleur says the packers plan to keep josh jacobs on their roster following the news of previous allegations against the running back who has pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend we re going to allow the nfl to do its process but i would anticipate him being a member of us moving forward lafleur said monday that s really all i have to speak on lafleur was asked why the packers weren t cutting ties with jacobs because we re just going to let everything kind of play out and obviously go from there he replied jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar incidents from years before after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations that surfaced in friday s records release josh took responsibility for what happened in may david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac said sunday in a statement he entered into an agreement with prosecutors for two misdemeanors and he is meeting the court s requirements the three accounts are old are hearsay and easily disproven yet released to the media by police without any investigation to determine whether they were accurate or contradicted by evidence josh is answering them in detail because of the character assassination that is occurring unfairly threatening his career jacobs lawyers said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl declined comment sunday on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from the other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation after charges were initially filed against jacobs lafleur said on sept 1 that i believe him and i trust him and added that i m going to do that until proven otherwise when jacobs came off the commissioner s exempt list and started practicing with the packers again two weeks ago lafleur said that i think people learn from their mistakes and i think he s extremely remorseful and i do believe that he s a good person lafleur was asked monday about his support for jacobs and whether anything had changed in that regard i m not going to get into that up here right now lafleur said we ll just let the process play out jacobs arrest followed a may 23 incident in which police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police a woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head since returning to the packers jacobs has 32 carries for 75 yards and a touchdown plus 11 catches for 68 yards and two more scores jacobs scored two touchdowns in a 27 19 victory over the carolina panthers on thursday and celebrated the first of those scores by briefly putting his hands together behind his back jacobs said after the game that he was paying homage to a gospel song titled break every chain but he was criticized on social media by people who believed he was simulating getting handcuffed that s something that he and i talked about lafleur said i know he had his explanation and i wasn t even aware of what happened until i saw the tape but we had a conversation about that and i m going to keep the conversation between him and i and you know we re going to move forward copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals name Gardner Minshew starting quarterback; rookie Carson Beck to be backup
news_mentions.description: Gardner Minshew will be Arizona's starter "moving forward," coach Mike LaFleur announced Monday, while rookie Carson Beck will be his backup, starting this Sunday against the Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: the cardinals are shuffling the deck at quarterback entering the back half of the season gardner minshew will be arizona s starter moving forward coach mike lafleur announced monday while rookie carson beck will be his backup starting in week 9 against the seahawks minshew replaces jacoby brissett who started arizona s first eight games but now slides into an emergency third qb role that s not easy lafleur said of demoting brissett who has led the cards to a 3 5 record it s not a fun phone call there s no book for that obviously there s a human element to it i have a lot of respect for jacoby the person i have a lot of respect for jacoby the player like i told you guys yesterday this was not all on him this was collective starting with me but the position that those guys sign up for we know the deal we needed a spark and obvious gardner gave us one minshew provided the spark in the third quarter of sunday s game against the cowboys when he entered for a benched brissett with arizona down 17 3 what followed was a mad cap comeback with minshew completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns leading five scoring drives including the game winning march in overtime to win 33 30 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven interceptions this season and was 10 of 23 passing for 119 yards and an int on sunday at the time of his benching they very well may have been his last snaps in arizona the journeyman s benching raises the question of whether he will be on the trade block ahead of the nov 10 deadline with qb injuries and questions mounting around the league a third string brissett 33 is an attractive trade target asked whether brissett could be on his way out of town lafleur said monday he was only focused on the upcoming week he s fully a part of this team lafleur said excited to see him still be the teammate i know he is minshew is slated to make his first start for arizona the 30 year old mustachioed man has started 47 games 64 games played for five nfl franchises since being selected by the jaguars in the sixth round of the 2019 draft minshew s appearance in week 8 was his first of the season he last started a game for kansas city in week 16 of last year brissett s demotion springboards beck the no 65 overall pick in the 2026 nfl draft into the qb2 role lafleur said the rookie is week to week with a back injury but is ready to step into the backup position i just think that s the right thing to do lafleur explained to continue his development in terms of getting more reps with the scout team and all that entering monday night football the cardinals rank 18th in passing yards per game 223 8 but 29th in pass yards per play 5 44 at 3 5 they have overperformed in the treacherous nfc west and are just one game back of the third place rams whom they face in week 10 whether brissett is on the roster by then is now a question as arizona looks to minshew as the answer under center

news_mentions.headline: Colts' Shane Steichen to 'evaluate everything, every position' after embarrassing loss in Jacksonville
news_mentions.description: The Indianapolis Colts lost their fourth straight game, this one in embarrassing fashion in a 42-7 loss in Jacksonville.
news_mentions.body_text: it s getting dark early in indianapolis the colts suffered another embarrassing loss on sunday getting their doors blown off 42 7 by rival jacksonville already amid a teardown it s the type of loss that puts more jobs in question coach shane steichen sits in the crosshairs after indy already parted ways with general manager chris ballard and traded away quenton nelson and deforest buckner it s one thing to be 2 6 it s a different matter to get walloped by a rival in disheartening fashion for a fourth straight loss it wasn t good enough flat out wasn t good enough steichen said via the indianapolis star we got outcoached we got outplayed and we ve got to freaking learn from our mistakes in a hurry the effort and the energy has to be there every week if not you re going to get beat like that the colts played like a team whose players know there is no coming back this season missed tackles botched offensive plays leading to turnovers ineffective quarterback play questionable play calls everything was a mess those issues fall squarely on steichen clearly i ve got to do a better job plain and simple steichen said it starts with me as the head coach i ve got to do a better job to get these guys ready to go that wasn t it today the question is how much longer steichen is the head coach clearly he couldn t get his players ready for a division opponent after the week of trades might indy be better served severing ties now than waiting until the new year i m focused on getting better steichen said that s what i m focused on right now beyond steichen s future the colts have several big questions between now and next week jonathan taylorcould be traded the rb had a big 19 yard run out of the gate on sunday but did little else the rest of the way earning 23 rushing yards on eight carries and a fumble on a botched trick play the colts may not have wanted to put taylor in harm s way with the trade deadline looming but once indy was down big there was little point in putting more tread on his tires regardless of how things play out then there is daniel jones who has struggled mightily this season on sunday he completed 19 of 28 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions before being sat in the blowout jones play has sunk like a rock this season he has missed passes and gets rattled any time there is pressure he looks like the jones who earned his ticket out of new york in 2024 his dismal play has jump started questions about whether the colts should give anthony richardson a shot i m going to evaluate everything every position going forward steichen said when asked if jones would remain his team s starting quarterback that evaluation should start with how he prepares his team to play

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars vs. Ravens: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 9 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the freefalling Ravens somehow find new life against a Jaguars team looking to prove it's a top contender? In advance of Thursday night's game between Jacksonville and Baltimore, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense there are already lists being compiled of quarterbacks the ravens should trade for so they don t have to play him he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week

news_mentions.headline: Week 9 NFL MVP tracker: Can Caleb Williams join Joe Montana in making history?
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at the MVP race heading into Week 9 on the 2026 season. Can Bears QB Caleb Williams do something only accomplished by Joe Montana? Plus, Joe Burrow makes a push into the top five.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams on monday night did what no quarterback has done this season bamboozle the seattle seahawks defense mike macdonald s group entered monday s tilt allowing a league low 144 4 passing yards per game and the stingiest total yards per game 233 9 no qb had hit the 200 yard passing mark against seattle this season the seahawks flustered brock purdy in week 5 into his lowest output 189 yards they flummoxed patrick mahomes 165 and stonewalled running back kenneth walker 36 in week 7 then the bears and williams rolled over them like a ford f 450 super duty blasting through a pinto en route to a 34 17 win williams completed 70 6 of his passes 24 for 34 for 247 yards and a touchdown with no interceptions his third game with at least one touchdown zero interceptions and a 70 or higher completion percentage this season tied for most in the nfl per nfl research williams is the first qb with such a game against the seahawks since baker mayfield in week 5 2025 jordan love and jared goff both in 2024 are the only other qbs with such a game against seattle since macdonald became the coach in 2024 mastermind ben johnson deserves credit for a chicago offense that keeps defenses off kilter the bears offensive line is as strong as any in the league the running backs keep yards churning and the wide receivers create space and gobble up yards after the catch but it all funnels through williams the qb was sublime on monday night in the face of the nfl s top defense in a hostile road environment at lumen field there were a few hiccups including some errant throws and three three and outs but overall williams showed he is in complete command of johnson s offense that should scare the rest of the nfc i went over williams improvement in year 2 under johnson in last week s column again the qb showed the ability to play within the offense and take the layups when they re there against the seahawks he also feasted off play action with a 40 0 downfield rate off play action and a 23 5 explosive play rate in week 8 his highest of the season per next gen stats what i didn t get into last week was how a hamstring injury that wiped out three games could dash any shot williams has at swiping this year s mvp award history says he s a long shot simply because of those missed games in the post nfl afl merger era since 1970 in non strike shortened seasons only one player has missed three games and still won the nfl mvp award joe montana in 1989 joe cool battled through various injuries that season missing weeks 6 8 and 15 and portions of others every single other mvp missed two or fewer tilts most missed zero here is a complete list of games missed for mvps since 1970 not counting john elway in 1987 and kicker mark moseley in 1982 both strike shortened years 1972 rb larry brown weeks 13 and 14 1989 qb joe montana weeks 6 8 15 1990 qb joe montana week 16 1991 rb thurman thomas week 17 1993 rb emmitt smith weeks 1 and 2 2000 rb marshall faulk weeks 9 and 10 2003 qb steve mcnair weeks 15 and 17 2011 qb aaron rodgers week 18 2019 qb lamar jackson week 18 2021 qb aaron rodgers week 9 2023 qb lamar jackson week 18 that s 11 players out of 53 who missed even a single game during their mvp seasons many of those came at the end of the regular season with players sitting out to prep for a postseason run aside from rodgers positive covid test in 2021 no qb has missed a game due to injury in their mvp season since steve mcnair in 2003 of the five mvps who missed more than a single game three were running backs who racked up enough stats to run away with the award emmitt smith famously sat out the first two games in a contract standoff with the cowboys in 1993 mcnair split the award with peyton manning after missing a couple of late games with calf and ankle injuries the titans qb led the nfl in passer rating and yards per attempt that year mvp voters have leaned toward qbs who rack up stats and stay on the field in 2016 there was some chatter particularly in the northeast as to whether tom brady who missed the first four games of the season due to the deflategate suspension should be considered for the mvp after returning to lead the pats to an 11 1 record with a 28 2 td int ratio brady finished second to the falcons matt ryan with 20 of the vote montana s 1989 season for san francisco sits as the lone outlier despite missing three games montana was the best qb on the best team in the nfl winning the mvp vote in a landslide 62 of 70 votes the 49ers qb overcame the lack of counting stats by leading the nfl in all the efficiency categories 70 2 completion rate a 6 7 td rate 53 7 success rate 9 1 yards per attempt average 270 8 yards per game and set the then record with a 112 4 passer rating when 100 passer ratings were uncommon that s williams path to the mvp be the most efficient passer on the best team the bears qb currently sits second in completion percentage 70 9 fourth in interception rate 0 6 eighth in success rate 49 7 fifth in yards per attempt 8 0 11th in yards per game 253 4 fifth in passer rating 104 6 while ranking second in qbr 78 9 third in epa per dropback 0 22 and fifth in win probability added 117 0 overcoming missed games in terms of the mvp race is extremely difficult missing three is historically daunting williams isn t there yet but if he manhandles other defenses like he did a studly seahawks one on the road he ll have a shot at joining montana as an outlier in the record books now on to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 8 edition next in line bears qb caleb williams lions qb jared goff jahmyr gibbs drake maye

news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 6 games: Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson ejected
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 6 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 6 sunday atlanta falcons linebacker divine deablo arm was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago linebacker kendal daniels neck was ruled out after he exited the game on a stretcher in the third quarter the falcons later announced that daniels is alert and has movement in his extremities daniels was taken to a local hospital for further evaluation baltimore ravens wide receiver rashod bateman shoulder was ruled out of sunday s loss to cleveland buffalo bills safety c j gardner johnson was ejected in the second quarter of sunday s game after appearing to spit at a raiders player chicago bears offensive lineman jonah jackson hip did not return to sunday s win over atlanta cleveland browns safety grant delpit concussion was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore dallas cowboys wide receiver kavontae turpin rib was ruled out of sunday s game against the packers lb dee winters ankle did not return against the packers green bay packers cb brandon cisse stinger did not return against the cowboys houston texans safety reed blankenship concussion was ruled out of sunday s win over jacksonville indianapolis colts cornerback sauce gardner calf did not return to sunday s loss to tennessee jacksonville jaguars safety antonio johnson ankle did not return to sunday s loss to houston kansas city chiefs right tackle jaylon moore left sunday s game against the chargers and is in the concussion protocol per the team cornerback christian roland wallace was ejected in the fourth quarter after appearing to throw a punch at a chargers player los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey and defensive back deane leonard were ruled out of sunday s game against kansas city after suffering concussions los angeles rams kicker blake grupe who was signed this week to replace harrison mevis suffered a knee injury in the first quarter and was ruled out against the cardinals new england patriots wide receiver romeo doubs shoulder and guard alijah vera tucker hamstring were ruled out of sunday s win over the jets offensive tackle morgan moses ankle and center ben brown knee were also ruled out new orleans saints guard cesar ruiz knee did not return to sunday s win over the giants new york giants cornerback greg newsome concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the saints wide receiver darnell mooney neck also did not return new york jets linebacker kiko mauigoa thigh did not return to sunday s loss to new england philadelphia eagles linebacker nolan smith was ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to carolina defensive tackle jordan davis ankle and running back carson steele shoulder were also ruled out tennessee titans safety tony adams ankle did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform
