news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 8 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen and the bills had a rough start against the ravens but the extra possessions afforded by a lifeless baltimore offense gave them plenty of time to figure things out congratulations are in order for allen who passed hall of famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen stats insights via nfl pro joe burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown against tennessee his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season burrow was also effective when the titans blitzed 30 2 third highest in a game by the titans this season completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards three touchdowns and an interception tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career tier 2 trevor lawrence shredded the colts throwing for 210 yards and three touchdowns on just 14 attempts that s the kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun disproportionately looking pickens way this week dak i m not banking on it fixing things geno smith has played much better than the jets 2 6 record suggests and i won t dock him for his late interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro cam ward completed 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against cincinnati the bengals used man coverage on 44 7 of their coverage snaps their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage his most completions yards and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career tier 4 sam darnold still hasn t found a comfortable place in an offense that cannot run the ball and relies disproportionately on jaxon smith njigba it works out sometimes smith njigba s slant and go produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably after a nightmarish week 7 outing throwing the panthers to a first half lead and flirting with a fourth quarter comeback against the packers he ll need better protection and might have to adjust his process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with his decisions but to his credit he did try to push the ball downfield a bit against the chiefs it s no surprise his most productive throws were still at or behind the line of scrimmage but hey at least he isn t hurting his team with turnovers malik willis wasn t quite as good as he was in week 7 but he still piloted the dolphins to a 13 3 halftime lead against the patriots the second half however reminded us of how far this entire dolphins team still has to go willis included next gen stats insights via nfl pro jayden daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the commanders win over the eagles more than two thirds of that yardage came against man coverage where he completed 8 of 13 passes for a career high 148 yards and a touchdown daniels was successful generating chunk plays completing all three of his deep attempts 20 air yards for 104 yards his most in a game since week 8 of the 2024 season against the bears he added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles tier 5 well i know kyler murray can make one throw the seam ball to t j hockenson it produced two big gains and a touchdown in another low scoring affair for the vikings who desperately need some balance if only to buy murray time to throw they re still far from reaching the ideal state with murray under center but they ve already made their bed at this point unless kevin o connell suddenly becomes intrigued by a quarterback elsewhere or gulp decides he d rather play carson wentz i hate to rank michael penix so low but i cannot excuse the four interceptions he threw on sunday regardless of the monsoon in which the falcons and bucs were playing it s clear the weather created difficult conditions that affected penix s performance but the gulf between penix s good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he threw one pass on sunday and suffered a thumb injury on that throw which might end his season after he d just missed three games due to an ankle injury worst of all his replacement is likely to land even lower on the index in future weeks in baker mayfield s two games since returning from a thumb injury he has completed 7 of 14 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown the buccaneers are 2 0 in those games he didn t complete a pass against the falcons though a ted hurst drop robbed him of a touchdown i remain curious to see if he can actually get back to his old ways because his current style of play cannot continue to produce wins next gen stats insights via nfl pro kyler murray threw for 210 yards two touchdowns and one interception in the vikings loss to the lions murray averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt his second highest mark in a game trailing only a week 3 of 2024 matchup against the lions 11 6 murray targeted downfield 10 air yards on 44 8 of his attempts his second highest rate as a viking on downfield attempts murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing 4 of 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 minimum 10 downfield attempts tier 6 i believe we ve seen the last of jacoby brissett in a game for the cardinals and frankly his benching was more revelatory than i anticipated his struggles i thought were a product of a bad offense but when gardner minshew replaced him against the cowboys and completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns i quickly learned brissett was part of the problem i m interested to see if another team tries to work a trade for him before the deadline otherwise he ll spend the rest of the season in the shadows to which he s been banished by mike lafleur editor s update the cardinals and ravens are finalizing a trade that will send brissett to baltimore per nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter tanner mckee looks more comfortable than he did last year but his productivity and viability as a starter hasn t yet lasted the full length of a game he and the eagles were incredibly ineffective in the second half of sunday night s loss which i fear is a precursor of more struggles to come editor s update the eagles are reportedly benching mckee in favor of joe milton for week 9 daniel jones continues to struggle with turnovers in an offense that features two players jonathan taylor and josh downs who could be traded soon the colts are in full teardown mode and jones isn t giving them many reasons to continue playing him even with their lack of confidence in anthony richardson we re left to wonder whether he might get benched or if he too could be on the move justin herbert threw two more interceptions against the rams the chargers haven t scored a touchdown in ages and the most prominent headline tied to herbert is speculative articles wondering whether he might get traded things are bad for the bolts and herbert remains a central figure in their demise next gen stats insights via nfl pro jacoby brissett was sacked three times and completed just 8 of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers against the cowboys resulting in his lowest completion percentage 40 0 when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in arizona brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards 51 across 17 fewer passes when blitzed 3 overall brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks 55 2 his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 8 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen and the bills had a rough start against the ravens but the extra possessions afforded by a lifeless baltimore offense gave them plenty of time to figure things out congratulations are in order for allen who passed hall of famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen stats insights via nfl pro joe burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown against tennessee his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season burrow was also effective when the titans blitzed 30 2 third highest in a game by the titans this season completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards three touchdowns and an interception tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career tier 2 trevor lawrence shredded the colts throwing for 210 yards and three touchdowns on just 14 attempts that s the kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun disproportionately looking pickens way this week dak i m not banking on it fixing things geno smith has played much better than the jets 2 6 record suggests and i won t dock him for his late interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro cam ward completed 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against cincinnati the bengals used man coverage on 44 7 of their coverage snaps their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage his most completions yards and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career tier 4 sam darnold still hasn t found a comfortable place in an offense that cannot run the ball and relies disproportionately on jaxon smith njigba it works out sometimes smith njigba s slant and go produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably after a nightmarish week 7 outing throwing the panthers to a first half lead and flirting with a fourth quarter comeback against the packers he ll need better protection and might have to adjust his process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with his decisions but to his credit he did try to push the ball downfield a bit against the chiefs it s no surprise his most productive throws were still at or behind the line of scrimmage but hey at least he isn t hurting his team with turnovers malik willis wasn t quite as good as he was in week 7 but he still piloted the dolphins to a 13 3 halftime lead against the patriots the second half however reminded us of how far this entire dolphins team still has to go willis included next gen stats insights via nfl pro jayden daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the commanders win over the eagles more than two thirds of that yardage came against man coverage where he completed 8 of 13 passes for a career high 148 yards and a touchdown daniels was successful generating chunk plays completing all three of his deep attempts 20 air yards for 104 yards his most in a game since week 8 of the 2024 season against the bears he added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles tier 5 well i know kyler murray can make one throw the seam ball to t j hockenson it produced two big gains and a touchdown in another low scoring affair for the vikings who desperately need some balance if only to buy murray time to throw they re still far from reaching the ideal state with murray under center but they ve already made their bed at this point unless kevin o connell suddenly becomes intrigued by a quarterback elsewhere or gulp decides he d rather play carson wentz i hate to rank michael penix so low but i cannot excuse the four interceptions he threw on sunday regardless of the monsoon in which the falcons and bucs were playing it s clear the weather created difficult conditions that affected penix s performance but the gulf between penix s good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he threw one pass on sunday and suffered a thumb injury on that throw which might end his season after he d just missed three games due to an ankle injury worst of all his replacement is likely to land even lower on the index in future weeks in baker mayfield s two games since returning from a thumb injury he has completed 7 of 14 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown the buccaneers are 2 0 in those games he didn t complete a pass against the falcons though a ted hurst drop robbed him of a touchdown i remain curious to see if he can actually get back to his old ways because his current style of play cannot continue to produce wins next gen stats insights via nfl pro kyler murray threw for 210 yards two touchdowns and one interception in the vikings loss to the lions murray averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt his second highest mark in a game trailing only a week 3 of 2024 matchup against the lions 11 6 murray targeted downfield 10 air yards on 44 8 of his attempts his second highest rate as a viking on downfield attempts murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing 4 of 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 minimum 10 downfield attempts tier 6 i believe we ve seen the last of jacoby brissett in a game for the cardinals and frankly his benching was more revelatory than i anticipated his struggles i thought were a product of a bad offense but when gardner minshew replaced him against the cowboys and completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns i quickly learned brissett was part of the problem i m interested to see if another team tries to work a trade for him before the deadline otherwise he ll spend the rest of the season in the shadows to which he s been banished by mike lafleur editor s update the cardinals and ravens are finalizing a trade that will send brissett to baltimore per nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter tanner mckee looks more comfortable than he did last year but his productivity and viability as a starter hasn t yet lasted the full length of a game he and the eagles were incredibly ineffective in the second half of sunday night s loss which i fear is a precursor of more struggles to come editor s update the eagles are reportedly benching mckee in favor of joe milton for week 9 daniel jones continues to struggle with turnovers in an offense that features two players jonathan taylor and josh downs who could be traded soon the colts are in full teardown mode and jones isn t giving them many reasons to continue playing him even with their lack of confidence in anthony richardson we re left to wonder whether he might get benched or if he too could be on the move justin herbert threw two more interceptions against the rams the chargers haven t scored a touchdown in ages and the most prominent headline tied to herbert is speculative articles wondering whether he might get traded things are bad for the bolts and herbert remains a central figure in their demise next gen stats insights via nfl pro jacoby brissett was sacked three times and completed just 8 of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers against the cowboys resulting in his lowest completion percentage 40 0 when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in arizona brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards 51 across 17 fewer passes when blitzed 3 overall brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks 55 2 his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season

news_mentions.headline: Deshaun Watson enters concussion protocol ahead of Browns' Week 9 game vs. Saints
news_mentions.description: The Browns announced Wednesday morning that Deshaun Watson was placed in concussion protocol Tuesday morning after self-reporting concussion symptoms stemming from Cleveland's Week 8 loss to Pittsburgh.
news_mentions.body_text: cleveland may be without its starting quarterback this sunday the browns announced wednesday morning that deshaun watson was placed in concussion protocol tuesday morning after self reporting concussion symptoms stemming from cleveland s week 8 loss to pittsburgh watson briefly left last sunday s game after a first quarter hit to the head from steelers safety jaquan brisker that resulted in a roughing the passer penalty watson missed four plays but returned to the game on the ensuing drive during the first quarter of sunday s game against the steelers deshaun took a helmet to helmet hit the browns said in a statement the atc spotter called down to the sideline and the unaffiliated neurotrauma consultant unc administered a gameday concussion evaluation deshaun was cleared by the unc and returned on the browns next offensive series as part of the protocol the team s medical staff evaluated him again postgame and monday morning both times he showed no symptoms passed his evaluations and was cleared on tuesday morning he reported to the medical staff that he began experiencing concussion symptoms monday night and was immediately placed in the concussion protocol with watson sidelined as he goes through protocol second year qb shedeur sanders is in line to start sunday against the new orleans saints dillon gabriel would likely be the backup qb in that scenario after a training camp and preseason qb battle watson was named cleveland s starter over sanders on aug 24 thought to be a stop gap at the position the 10th year veteran has instead led the browns to a 5 3 record and even earned some speculative comeback player of the year chatter over eight games watson has completed 65 5 of his passes for 1 806 yards seven touchdowns and three interceptions for a 91 2 passer rating playing his best ball since 2020 while he paces the nfl with five game winning drives he does also lead all quarterbacks with 33 sacks taken sanders has made two appearances this season completing three pass attempts for 2 yards the 24 year old was cleveland s starter down the stretch of the 2025 season leading the browns to a 3 4 record while throwing for 1 400 yards seven tds and 10 ints he was even named to the pro bowl as an alternate cleveland kicks off in new orleans on sunday at 1 p m et which signal caller will be under center remains to be seen

news_mentions.headline: Bears-Seahawks on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Chicago's 34-17 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down Chicago's win on Monday night over the reigning Super Bowl champion, Seattle.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago makes another statement as contenders the bears beat the reigning afc champion last week at home as an encore they went ahead and took down the reigning super bowl champions on the road at lumen field one of the most formidable stadiums in the league for visiting teams the latter victory was perhaps their most impressive of the season chicago led wire to wire immediately quieting seattle s home crowd by forcing a three and out and following it up with an 80 yard touchdown march that took 17 plays the most against seattle on a td drive in 10 years per nfl research caleb williams threw for 247 yards against a defense that had been allowing 144 4 passing yards per game with no previous signal caller going over 176 yards the bears offense put up 363 yards total another high allowed by the seahawks who are one of three teams in the past 20 seasons to allow 301 or fewer yards in each of their first seven games chicago s defense was swarming sacking sam darnold three times picking him off once and holding seattle to 252 total yards only 1 more than the seahawks season low and the special teams that unit blocked a critical field goal in the first minute of the fourth quarter when the game was still close the bears set the tone early responded when necessary and outlasted the champs for what turned out to be a comfortable margin of victory who would deny them as contenders at this point seahawks aren t playing complementary football seattle s defense fought about as courageously as a unit could while giving up 34 points for much of the night as the seahawks offense floundered the defense kept them in it holding the bears to six points over their last five first half possessions after the odyssey that was chicago s opening td drive the defense also forced a three and out right after halftime which the offense rudely paid back with its fourth three and out of the game in the end the dark side d wore down at fault for the points allowed but hardly the reason the seahawks lost sam darnold and co were completely outmatched they went one of 11 on third down a symptom of offensive coordinator brian fleury s confounding plan to run or throw short on early downs despite it constantly resulting in playing behind the sticks darnold looked jumpy throughout while completing only half of his passes going 17 of 34 for 188 yards two touchdowns and an interception and the run game continually ran into a brick wall the seahawks are now 1 2 in their last three games during which they ve averaged 12 3 points per game while giving up a respectable 22 7 points per game they went 1 2 in their three games before that as well although during that stretch it was the defense that momentarily lost its way from week 3 5 the seahawks averaged 30 points per game but allowed 29 3 per outing the unevenness has resulted in a 4 4 record tied with the rams in the middle of the nfc west and only one game ahead of the cellar dwelling cardinals the two sides must find their stride simultaneously moving forward to have any hope of sustaining a winning streak simmons effect the immediacy with which jeffery simmons made an impact on monday night s game was impressive traded from a one win team to the reigning nfc north champions on thursday and three days later playing his first prime time game in three years the perennial pro bowler put on a menacing performance from the start his most showy display of dominance came on his fourth snap as a bear simmons swam past grey zabel with ease burst into the backfield and flung sam darnold to the ground for a sack with ferocity it was a massive play unfortunately minimized by grady jarrett committing a face mask penalty after the whistle but it still provided an early sign of what could be for the bears who finally have a difference maker on the interior and stayed charged up to force a punt three plays later anyway simmons logged three tackles a qb pressure and the sack in his first 10 snaps and by game s end had a team leading six tackles a sack a qb hit a pass deflection and two tackles for loss chicago s defense had been playing well this year ranking ninth in both points and yards allowed entering week 8 but the unit rendered seattle hopeless for large swaths of monday night instead of being overwhelmed by the 12s on the road the bears d instead fed off its own contagious atmosphere it s all thanks to the man in the orange sleeves an alteration from the red he rocked with the titans for all those years prior jsn and who else you would think the returns of zach charbonnet and jadarian price plus the addition of guard quenton nelson would provide a big boost to seattle s running game sadly for the seahawks that was far from the case price managed a meager 29 yards on 10 carries while charbonnet had six carries for 23 yards seattle s 81 rushing yards were its second lowest on the season and even reaching that total seemed an arduous task with the bears regularly taking away would be lanes and the running backs too often opting to bail out to try to find space laterally when it came to passing jaxon smith njigba was essentially the entire operation he accounted for 92 of the team s 94 passing yards by halftime with four catches to the rest of the team s three he made tyrique stevenson look downright foolish on his second quarter touchdown leaving the safety in the dust by faking in for a slant before cutting upfield and streaking down the sideline all alone but when the bears finally silenced him over the next two quarters seattle s already quiet supporting cast didn t get any louder tory horton finished with three catches for 26 yards aj barner contributed 23 yards on two snags price charbonnet and cooper kupp each failed to hit double digits in receiving yards and they combined for six catches smith njigba is an all world receiver but where in the world is the other production coming from in this offense williams spreads the wealth just as they did last week the bears opened up with a heightened focus on luther burden the second year wideout collected four catches for 23 yards and a touchdown on chicago s opening drive he led the team in receptions six and yards 53 at halftime and again just like last week he hardly contributed to the stat sheet in the second half adding only one more catch for 3 yards while rome odunze began heating up to end with 87 yards on four catches colston loveland who tied burden for the team lead with nine targets catching seven of them for 65 yards enjoyed the most balanced game in terms of catching williams eye he did fumble however gifting the seahawks a short field to eventually make it a three point game in the final frame yet another playmaker showed up as part of chicago s response to the gaffe after a delay of game penalty fortuitously saved the bears from having a run blown up on third and 4 kalif raymond took his turn catching a backward pass from williams on the ensuing third and 9 and splitting a crowd of seahawks to take the 39 yard run down to seattle s 5 d 39 andre swift who averaged only 2 6 yards per carry on 27 attempts punched it in from there his second of a hat trick of rushing touchdowns on the night the bears offense is the complete opposite of seattle s jsn centric attack everyone can do damage it s impossible to predict who is going to hurt you and that s what makes it so dangerous next gen stats insight for bears seahawks via nfl pro caleb williams completed 10 of his 15 play action pass attempts 66 7 for 109 yards and one touchdown against the seahawks his 47 2 play action rate is his highest this season and the fourth highest by a quarterback this season minimum 25 attempts nfl research the bears became the first team in nfl history to beat both super bowl participants from the previous season in back to back prime time games

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars vs. Ravens: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 9 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the freefalling Ravens somehow find new life against a Jaguars team looking to prove it's a top contender? In advance of Thursday night's game between Jacksonville and Baltimore, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: the jaguars have only one more win than the ravens this season but the gap between these two teams suddenly feels much wider than their records suggest baltimore is facing a catastrophic quarterback situation two time mvp lamar jackson is heading for injured reserve after suffering an injury to his right thumb on the offense s first play from scrimmage in last week s game and backup tyler huntley is reportedly out for the season with turf toe which means undrafted rookie joe fagnano will be making his first career start on thursday in prime time the ravens are desperate for a win after three straight losses all to afc foes sank them to the bottom of the afc north the afc south leading jaguars made easy work of the stripped down colts at home last week can first year head coach jesse minter find a way to keep his squad afloat against a team eyeing a second straight division title let s consider a few key subplots for thursday night s tilt three must know storylines 1 are the jaguars inevitable no team has completed 50 of its regular season schedule entering week 9 and yet it already feels like the jaguars are a lock to host at least one playoff game in january they have a 95 playoff probability and a 90 chance of winning the afc south the highest division title odds of any team in the league per next gen stats their three wins by 20 plus points in 2026 are the most in the nfl also they have the easiest remaining strength of schedule of any team 416 that is where the challenge for liam coen now lies can he keep a heavily favored team from taking its foot off the gas when it s clearly in such an envious position it wasn t an issue last week against a colts squad that had traded away two of its best players in the days leading up to the game with jacksonville scoring 42 points in the first three quarters of a boat race trevor lawrence didn t even play in the fourth quarter yes the jags were well rested coming off a week 7 bye after their two week stay in london turning around and doing it again on the road with a condensed week of preparation is a different undertaking 2 is joe fagnano ready for his close up the undrafted rookie finds himself in a daunting situation ahead of his first career start with just a few days to prepare for the league s no 2 scoring defense there are already lists being compiled of quarterbacks the ravens should trade for so they don t have to play him he completed 10 of 21 passes for 91 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in his regular season debut a relief appearance for lamar jackson and tyler huntley against a much more forgiving defense in buffalo on sunday also fagnano is dealing with an injury of his own wearing a brace on his ankle during tuesday s practice the 25 year old has plenty of collegiate experience making 44 starts across seven seasons he posted a touchdown to interception ratio of 48 6 in his three seasons at uconn at 6 foot 3 230 pounds he has the size to play the position in the pros he has the potential to be an efficient distributor of the football but he s not going to flash any of the playmaking ability ravens fans are accustomed to seeing from jackson and to a lesser degree huntley managing a clean game would be an achievement by fagnano against the jaguars who are one of three teams with more interceptions than touchdown passes allowed this season it would help if he could get the ball to leading receiver zay flowers who didn t have a catch on five targets four by fagnano last week 3 can the ravens avoid the abyss while the jaguars playoff odds continue to surge the ravens have watched their chances fade away they ve gone from a 70 playoff probability to 20 in the span of four weeks so thursday would be a great time for jesse minter to pull a rabbit out of a hat he made his bones as a defensive coordinator and he still has elite talent to work with on that side of the ball including all pro safety kyle hamilton of course baltimore won t have any hope on thursday night if it can t get two time rushing king derrick henry going he has not reached 60 rushing yards in any game during the team s losing streak and now he ll face a defense that will undoubtedly be expecting a steady diet of henry carries with an undrafted rookie making his first career start under center the jaguars have the no 1 rushing defense in the nfl and allow a league low 3 4 yards per carry but that unit will be tested following the loss of run stuffing defensive tackle davon hamilton who suffered a season ending torn quadriceps muscle last week

news_mentions.headline: Week 9 NFL MVP tracker: Can Caleb Williams join Joe Montana in making history?
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at the MVP race heading into Week 9 on the 2026 season. Can Bears QB Caleb Williams do something only accomplished by Joe Montana? Plus, Joe Burrow makes a push into the top five.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams on monday night did what no quarterback has done this season bamboozle the seattle seahawks defense mike macdonald s group entered monday s tilt allowing a league low 144 4 passing yards per game and the stingiest total yards per game 233 9 no qb had hit the 200 yard passing mark against seattle this season the seahawks flustered brock purdy in week 5 into his lowest output 189 yards they flummoxed patrick mahomes 165 and stonewalled running back kenneth walker 36 in week 7 then the bears and williams rolled over them like a ford f 450 super duty blasting through a pinto en route to a 34 17 win williams completed 70 6 of his passes 24 for 34 for 247 yards and a touchdown with no interceptions his third game with at least one touchdown zero interceptions and a 70 or higher completion percentage this season tied for most in the nfl per nfl research williams is the first qb with such a game against the seahawks since baker mayfield in week 5 2025 jordan love and jared goff both in 2024 are the only other qbs with such a game against seattle since macdonald became the coach in 2024 mastermind ben johnson deserves credit for a chicago offense that keeps defenses off kilter the bears offensive line is as strong as any in the league the running backs keep yards churning and the wide receivers create space and gobble up yards after the catch but it all funnels through williams the qb was sublime on monday night in the face of the nfl s top defense in a hostile road environment at lumen field there were a few hiccups including some errant throws and three three and outs but overall williams showed he is in complete command of johnson s offense that should scare the rest of the nfc i went over williams improvement in year 2 under johnson in last week s column again the qb showed the ability to play within the offense and take the layups when they re there against the seahawks he also feasted off play action with a 40 0 downfield rate off play action and a 23 5 explosive play rate in week 8 his highest of the season per next gen stats what i didn t get into last week was how a hamstring injury that wiped out three games could dash any shot williams has at swiping this year s mvp award history says he s a long shot simply because of those missed games in the post nfl afl merger era since 1970 in non strike shortened seasons only one player has missed three games and still won the nfl mvp award joe montana in 1989 joe cool battled through various injuries that season missing weeks 6 8 and 15 and portions of others every single other mvp missed two or fewer tilts most missed zero here is a complete list of games missed for mvps since 1970 not counting john elway in 1987 and kicker mark moseley in 1982 both strike shortened years 1972 rb larry brown weeks 13 and 14 1989 qb joe montana weeks 6 8 15 1990 qb joe montana week 16 1991 rb thurman thomas week 17 1993 rb emmitt smith weeks 1 and 2 2000 rb marshall faulk weeks 9 and 10 2003 qb steve mcnair weeks 15 and 17 2011 qb aaron rodgers week 18 2019 qb lamar jackson week 18 2021 qb aaron rodgers week 9 2023 qb lamar jackson week 18 that s 11 players out of 53 who missed even a single game during their mvp seasons many of those came at the end of the regular season with players sitting out to prep for a postseason run aside from rodgers positive covid test in 2021 no qb has missed a game due to injury in their mvp season since steve mcnair in 2003 of the five mvps who missed more than a single game three were running backs who racked up enough stats to run away with the award emmitt smith famously sat out the first two games in a contract standoff with the cowboys in 1993 mcnair split the award with peyton manning after missing a couple of late games with calf and ankle injuries the titans qb led the nfl in passer rating and yards per attempt that year mvp voters have leaned toward qbs who rack up stats and stay on the field in 2016 there was some chatter particularly in the northeast as to whether tom brady who missed the first four games of the season due to the deflategate suspension should be considered for the mvp after returning to lead the pats to an 11 1 record with a 28 2 td int ratio brady finished second to the falcons matt ryan with 20 of the vote montana s 1989 season for san francisco sits as the lone outlier despite missing three games montana was the best qb on the best team in the nfl winning the mvp vote in a landslide 62 of 70 votes the 49ers qb overcame the lack of counting stats by leading the nfl in all the efficiency categories 70 2 completion rate a 6 7 td rate 53 7 success rate 9 1 yards per attempt average 270 8 yards per game and set the then record with a 112 4 passer rating when 100 passer ratings were uncommon that s williams path to the mvp be the most efficient passer on the best team the bears qb currently sits second in completion percentage 70 9 fourth in interception rate 0 6 eighth in success rate 49 7 fifth in yards per attempt 8 0 11th in yards per game 253 4 fifth in passer rating 104 6 while ranking second in qbr 78 9 third in epa per dropback 0 22 and fifth in win probability added 117 0 overcoming missed games in terms of the mvp race is extremely difficult missing three is historically daunting williams isn t there yet but if he manhandles other defenses like he did a studly seahawks one on the road he ll have a shot at joining montana as an outlier in the record books now on to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 8 edition next in line bears qb caleb williams lions qb jared goff jahmyr gibbs drake maye
