news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 8 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen and the bills had a rough start against the ravens but the extra possessions afforded by a lifeless baltimore offense gave them plenty of time to figure things out congratulations are in order for allen who passed hall of famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen stats insights via nfl pro joe burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown against tennessee his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season burrow was also effective when the titans blitzed 30 2 third highest in a game by the titans this season completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards three touchdowns and an interception tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career tier 2 trevor lawrence shredded the colts throwing for 210 yards and three touchdowns on just 14 attempts that s the kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun disproportionately looking pickens way this week dak i m not banking on it fixing things geno smith has played much better than the jets 2 6 record suggests and i won t dock him for his late interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro cam ward completed 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against cincinnati the bengals used man coverage on 44 7 of their coverage snaps their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage his most completions yards and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career tier 4 sam darnold still hasn t found a comfortable place in an offense that cannot run the ball and relies disproportionately on jaxon smith njigba it works out sometimes smith njigba s slant and go produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably after a nightmarish week 7 outing throwing the panthers to a first half lead and flirting with a fourth quarter comeback against the packers he ll need better protection and might have to adjust his process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with his decisions but to his credit he did try to push the ball downfield a bit against the chiefs it s no surprise his most productive throws were still at or behind the line of scrimmage but hey at least he isn t hurting his team with turnovers malik willis wasn t quite as good as he was in week 7 but he still piloted the dolphins to a 13 3 halftime lead against the patriots the second half however reminded us of how far this entire dolphins team still has to go willis included next gen stats insights via nfl pro jayden daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the commanders win over the eagles more than two thirds of that yardage came against man coverage where he completed 8 of 13 passes for a career high 148 yards and a touchdown daniels was successful generating chunk plays completing all three of his deep attempts 20 air yards for 104 yards his most in a game since week 8 of the 2024 season against the bears he added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles tier 5 well i know kyler murray can make one throw the seam ball to t j hockenson it produced two big gains and a touchdown in another low scoring affair for the vikings who desperately need some balance if only to buy murray time to throw they re still far from reaching the ideal state with murray under center but they ve already made their bed at this point unless kevin o connell suddenly becomes intrigued by a quarterback elsewhere or gulp decides he d rather play carson wentz i hate to rank michael penix so low but i cannot excuse the four interceptions he threw on sunday regardless of the monsoon in which the falcons and bucs were playing it s clear the weather created difficult conditions that affected penix s performance but the gulf between penix s good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he threw one pass on sunday and suffered a thumb injury on that throw which might end his season after he d just missed three games due to an ankle injury worst of all his replacement is likely to land even lower on the index in future weeks in baker mayfield s two games since returning from a thumb injury he has completed 7 of 14 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown the buccaneers are 2 0 in those games he didn t complete a pass against the falcons though a ted hurst drop robbed him of a touchdown i remain curious to see if he can actually get back to his old ways because his current style of play cannot continue to produce wins next gen stats insights via nfl pro kyler murray threw for 210 yards two touchdowns and one interception in the vikings loss to the lions murray averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt his second highest mark in a game trailing only a week 3 of 2024 matchup against the lions 11 6 murray targeted downfield 10 air yards on 44 8 of his attempts his second highest rate as a viking on downfield attempts murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing 4 of 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 minimum 10 downfield attempts tier 6 i believe we ve seen the last of jacoby brissett in a game for the cardinals and frankly his benching was more revelatory than i anticipated his struggles i thought were a product of a bad offense but when gardner minshew replaced him against the cowboys and completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns i quickly learned brissett was part of the problem i m interested to see if another team tries to work a trade for him before the deadline otherwise he ll spend the rest of the season in the shadows to which he s been banished by mike lafleur editor s update the cardinals and ravens are finalizing a trade that will send brissett to baltimore per nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter tanner mckee looks more comfortable than he did last year but his productivity and viability as a starter hasn t yet lasted the full length of a game he and the eagles were incredibly ineffective in the second half of sunday night s loss which i fear is a precursor of more struggles to come editor s update the eagles are reportedly benching mckee in favor of joe milton for week 9 daniel jones continues to struggle with turnovers in an offense that features two players jonathan taylor and josh downs who could be traded soon the colts are in full teardown mode and jones isn t giving them many reasons to continue playing him even with their lack of confidence in anthony richardson we re left to wonder whether he might get benched or if he too could be on the move justin herbert threw two more interceptions against the rams the chargers haven t scored a touchdown in ages and the most prominent headline tied to herbert is speculative articles wondering whether he might get traded things are bad for the bolts and herbert remains a central figure in their demise next gen stats insights via nfl pro jacoby brissett was sacked three times and completed just 8 of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers against the cowboys resulting in his lowest completion percentage 40 0 when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in arizona brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards 51 across 17 fewer passes when blitzed 3 overall brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks 55 2 his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals to trade QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens
news_mentions.description: The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: sometimes nfl teams do make the obvious moves the baltimore ravens are finalizing a trade for arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday the deal is expected to be completed over the weekend terms of the swap were not reported and cardinals head coach mike lafleur declined to go into details or confirm the deal out of respect for the process i ll let the process play out with that said lafleur via the cardinals website s darren urban before adding he expected it all to play out in the next few days brissett was benched during sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and demoted to third string on monday the benching coupled with the ravens glaring need at quarterback after losing lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury this week made a swap all too obvious not only was the need clear but brissett will reunite with ravens qb coach israel woolfolk with whom he worked last season in arizona and in cleveland in 2022 that familiarity will help the veteran qb to jump right into the fray it made sense for arizona to move on from brissett after naming gardner minshew the starter and carson beck the backup eventually beck should get some starting reps by trading brissett the cards also shed salary after reworking the qb s deal this offseason the ravens won t acquire brissett before thursday s game against jacksonville but he s expected to start when baltimore faces the los angeles chargers in week 10 on monday night football undrafted rookie joe fagnano will start on thursday night football versus the jags the ravens will be brissett s seventh franchise and mark his seventh different team in seven years the journeyman knows how to pick up an offense and can run the operation in arizona some off target throws began to hurt the offense and he didn t seem the best fit in mike lafleur s scheme but he s a professional who can at least give the ravens an operational distributor losers of three straight heading into thursday night the ravens hope brissett s arrival can help keep them afloat in a tough playoff race baltimore currently sits last in the division at 4 4 and 10th in the afc

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold to miss Week 9 game vs. Cardinals due to quad injury
news_mentions.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will miss Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals due to a quad injury, head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters on Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the seahawks recent offensive struggles look like they could worsen in week 9 quarterback sam darnold will not play in seattle s game against the arizona cardinals on sunday due to a quadriceps injury suffered late in monday night s loss to the chicago bears coach mike macdonald announced wednesday macdonald added that the plan is for drew lock who is dealing with an elbow injury to start in place of darnold sam injured his quad at the end of the game so sam s going to be out this week macdonald said it s going to be week to week for sam he s not going to go on injured reserve the news leads the seahawks to a place that has become familiar in 2026 darnold injured his glute during the first possession of seattle s season opening win over new england forcing lock into action for the rest of that contest and the ensuing game darnold missed the ensuing week and lock completed 19 of 26 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns in a lopsided win over the cardinals in arizona lock s health status isn t entirely guaranteed either the quarterback is dealing with an elbow injury and was listed as the emergency third quarterback in week 8 with jalen milroe dressing as darnold s backup with darnold once again on the mend lock will have to play through whatever elbow discomfort remains as the seahawks attempt to improve their 4 4 record against a cardinals team that has won two of the last three games and is also rolling out a new starter in gardner minshew

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Eagles to start Joe Milton over Tanner McKee in Week 9 vs. Giants
news_mentions.description: The free-falling Philadelphia Eagles are making a quarterback change in hopes of jumpstarting a flailing offense.
news_mentions.body_text: the free falling philadelphia eagles are making a quarterback change in hopes of jumpstarting a flailing offense the eagles are naming joe milton as their starting qb and benching tanner mckee for sunday s game versus the new york giants nfl network s mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported the eagles signed milton off the dallas cowboys practice squad on oct 16 after starter jalen hurts went on injured reserve due to blood clots a 2024 sixth round pick by the new england patriots milton has appeared in five games in his career all as a reserve while he wasn t the official starter in week 18 of his rookie campaign with the patriots he played the bulk of the tilt completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and ran for another score last year in dallas he subbed in four tilts completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with a td and two ints and rushing for 50 yards on five carries an enticing athlete milton brings a completely different style from mckee milton s ability to use his legs should help an offense that has struggled to block and suffered far too many stalled drives the strong armed 26 year old can hunt big plays which also can get him into trouble he ll get a shot to prove he can evolve with more seasoning in philly the eagles bench mckee after three starts all losses he completed 72 of 114 passes for 638 yards and two tds with two ints in sunday s loss to washington the eagles couldn t find consistent offense under mckee after the first quarter and a 10 0 lead turned into a 27 10 loss mckee lost the preseason backup battle to andy dalton and entered the season as qb3 however after dalton s one wayward interception against the bears in week 3 while hurts was getting checked for a concussion philly moved on from dalton who eventually signed in atlanta now the eagles are on to qb4 with sixth straight losses philly s season feels all but over for nick sirianni s club it doesn t hurt to see what an athlete like milton could provide things can t get much worse and milton at least provides the upside to make the offense exciting once in a while

news_mentions.headline: Brandon Aiyuk files to be reinstated from 49ers' reserve/left squad list
news_mentions.description: Brandon Aiyuk has turned in paperwork to be reinstated, his new agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN. He is currently on the 49ers’ reserve/left squad list and plans to report to the club’s training facility Friday afternoon.
news_mentions.body_text: brandon aiyuk is taking a required step toward a potential return aiyuk has turned in paperwork to be reinstated his new agent drew rosenhaus told espn the wide receiver is currently on the san francisco 49ers reserve left squad list and plans to report to the club s training facility friday afternoon brandon is healthy and ready to get back on the field rosenhaus told espn the 49ers placed aiyuk on the reserve left squad list after he stopped showing up late last season while rehabilitating a knee injury that has sidelined him since october 2024 as part of the process the team voided his guaranteed money aiyuk could have moved to be reinstated at any point which would have forced the niners hand until now he had declined to do so with the wideout planning to report later this week the 49ers options will be reinstate and play him under his current contract release him or reinstate him and try to find a trade partner before the nov 10 deadline san francisco has consistently said aiyuk would no longer be part of the club a stance kyle shanahan reiterated in september despite wr injuries the niners never wavered on that posture however the team also wasn t in any hurry to release the wideout until it had a reason to now it appears san francisco will be forced to act asked for his reaction to the aiyuk news shanahan said wednesday that he had none i have no expectation the 49ers coach added i ve kinda moved on with that mentally and everything doing kinda how i talked to you two months ago nothing s really changed for me in 69 games with the niners aiyuk 28 generated 4 305 yards on 294 catches with 25 first downs the former first round pick has not played since oct 20 2024

news_mentions.headline: Bengals WR Tee Higgins, Cardinals RB Tyler Allgeier highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Arizona running back Tyler Allgeier and Cincinnati wide receiver Tee Higgins earned top offensive honors for their Week 8 showings.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 8 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week after a monster sunday in which he hauled in 10 receptions for 155 yards and two touchdowns during the bengals 43 36 overtime win against the titans higgins earned his first ever afc offensive player of the week award the 2025 pro bowler had a 17 yard td catch in the third quarter and an 18 yard score with 3 46 to go that sent the game to ot bengals quarterback joe burrow who had six total tds on sunday has nine player of the week nods and cincy teammate ja 39 marr chase who had 11 grabs for 141 yards and a td versus tennessee has five potw honors now higgins has earned a long awaited first accolade of his own nfc offensive player of the week with the arizona running back ranks depleted allgeier stepped up in a huge way during the cardinals 33 30 overtime victory against the cowboys on sunday allgeier s spectacular 63 yard touchdown run keyed a performance in which he had 147 rushing yards on just 11 carries 13 3 yards per carry along with five receptions for 44 yards and a touchdown the former falcons back has now earned his first career player of the week nod afc defensive player of the week in just his second nfl start lane garnered his first career interception and made it one to remember lane s 92 yard pick six was perhaps the brightest highlight of the jaguars 42 7 win over the colts on sunday the pick wasn t lane s only contribution however as the 2025 sixth round pick recorded four tackles and three pass breakups en route to his first player of the week honor nfc defensive player of the week in a torrential tampa bay 16 0 win over atlanta anzalone was a catalyst in the shutout victory the former lions linebacker earned his first career player of the week award after posting two interceptions six tackles two passes defensed and one tackle for loss afc special teams player of the week laube recorded the nfl s first kickoff return for a touchdown this season in his raiders 38 33 win over the jets on sunday laube s kr td was the first of his career and also the first for the raiders franchise since 2011 nfc special teams player of the week as the lions knocked the vikings from the ranks of the unbeaten on sunday fox played a pivotal role in detroit s 19 15 win fox punted four times averaging 46 5 yards per boot and placing three punts inside the 20 yard line for his performance fox has earned his second career nfc special teams player of the week accolade with his first coming in week 3 of 2024

news_mentions.headline: Deshaun Watson enters concussion protocol ahead of Browns' Week 9 game vs. Saints
news_mentions.description: The Browns announced Wednesday morning that Deshaun Watson was placed in concussion protocol Tuesday morning after self-reporting concussion symptoms stemming from Cleveland's Week 8 loss to Pittsburgh.
news_mentions.body_text: cleveland may be without its starting quarterback this sunday the browns announced wednesday morning that deshaun watson was placed in concussion protocol tuesday morning after self reporting concussion symptoms stemming from cleveland s week 8 loss to pittsburgh watson briefly left last sunday s game after a first quarter hit to the head from steelers safety jaquan brisker that resulted in a roughing the passer penalty watson missed four plays but returned to the game on the ensuing drive during the first quarter of sunday s game against the steelers deshaun took a helmet to helmet hit the browns said in a statement the atc spotter called down to the sideline and the unaffiliated neurotrauma consultant unc administered a gameday concussion evaluation deshaun was cleared by the unc and returned on the browns next offensive series as part of the protocol the team s medical staff evaluated him again postgame and monday morning both times he showed no symptoms passed his evaluations and was cleared on tuesday morning he reported to the medical staff that he began experiencing concussion symptoms monday night and was immediately placed in the concussion protocol with watson sidelined as he goes through protocol second year qb shedeur sanders is in line to start sunday against the new orleans saints dillon gabriel would likely be the backup qb in that scenario after a training camp and preseason qb battle watson was named cleveland s starter over sanders on aug 24 thought to be a stop gap at the position the 10th year veteran has instead led the browns to a 5 3 record and even earned some speculative comeback player of the year chatter over eight games watson has completed 65 5 of his passes for 1 806 yards seven touchdowns and three interceptions for a 91 2 passer rating playing his best ball since 2020 while he paces the nfl with five game winning drives he does also lead all quarterbacks with 33 sacks taken sanders has made two appearances this season completing three pass attempts for 2 yards the 24 year old was cleveland s starter down the stretch of the 2025 season leading the browns to a 3 4 record while throwing for 1 400 yards seven tds and 10 ints he was even named to the pro bowl as an alternate cleveland kicks off in new orleans on sunday at 1 p m et which signal caller will be under center remains to be seen

news_mentions.headline: Eagles DC Vic Fangio: Giants got a 'steal' in QB J.J. McCarthy
news_mentions.description: The Giants shipped a fifth-round pick to Minnesota for J.J. McCarthy earlier this season. Ahead of Sunday’s NFC East matchup, Eagles DC Vic Fangio said he's impressed that Big Blue acquired the QB for so little.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants shipped a fifth round pick to minnesota for j j mccarthy earlier this season ahead of sunday s nfc east matchup philadelphia eagles defensive coordinator vic fangio said he s impressed that big blue acquired the qb for so little the quarterback has come in in a short period of time and really done a nice job for them to get him for a fifth round pick is a steal fangio said tuesday at the end of a long winded breakdown of the giants offseason changes mccarthy has played just six quarters for the giants but was very impressive in the week 7 overtime victory over the houston texans generating 252 yards on 20 of 28 passing mccarthy looked much more confident and accurate than at any time in minnesota the question for the nfc east leading giants is whether the qb s play in new york is replicable or whether it s simply a small sample and he ll revert to the same inconsistent passer we saw in minnesota much of how mccarthy plays will come down to the staff around him the coaching crew put the qb in position to make a lot of plays through his first six quarters that must continue fangio who worked under giants coach john harbaugh for two seasons in baltimore respects the job the offense in new york has done this season to turn things around they ve got a really good offense fangio said they ve got skill at the receiving position they did a nice job raiding the ravens not only for john but for tight end isaiah likely and fullback patrick ricard they ve got a lot of the ravens type offense that they had when giants senior offensive assistant greg roman was there and they ve intermixed kansas city type passing in there with offensive coordinator matt nagy they ve got it going right now they ve got good wideouts good tight ends two good backs fangio s eagles defense has struggled this season ranking 27th in yards allowed and 21st in points given up the pass rush has been sorely lacking ranking 23rd in qb pressures and 29th in sacks if they don t disrupt mccarthy on sunday the young giants quarterback could have another big day

news_mentions.headline: Aaron Rodgers: Division-leading Steelers 'right where we want to be' despite incomplete win
news_mentions.description: The Steelers enter the bye week at 6-2 after a blowout win over the Browns. Aaron Rodgers knows there is still room for improvement, particularly with the offense.
news_mentions.body_text: the pittsburgh steelers enter the bye week at 6 2 after a blowout win over the cleveland browns avenging an early season loss to the rival quarterback aaron rodgers knows there is still room for improvement particularly with the offense not very complete rodgers said of the win over the browns via the team s official website defense played excellent special teams did fine but offense should have had a lot more points there were a couple opportunities we didn t execute down there on the goal line the steelers racked up 361 yards but also went 4 of 11 on third downs and kicked two field goals in the red zone rodgers knows they ll need to finish better to get where they want to go we d like to play our best and still win he said we also like to win the defense and rushing attack have keyed the steelers early wins jaylen warren remains among the league s most dynamic runners the shifty back posted 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries against cleveland including a 51 yard scamper warren has 998 scrimmage yards in 2026 the most by a steelers player through eight games since james conner had 1 085 yards in 2018 warren now has 222 rush yards over expected this season second most in the nfl behind only kenneth walker 263 in week 8 warrant was complemented by rico dowdle who blasted the browns up the gut for 56 yards and another td on 15 carries the steelers are a run funnel offense with a 42 year old it shouldn t be a surprise that the passing attack is a slog at times rodgers turns back the clock and makes an mvp level throw but overall it s an inefficient passing attack we re 6 2 going into the bye first in the division rodgers said we re right where we want to be the steelers will exit the bye with a rematch with the cincinnati bengals pittsburgh bested joe burrow co in week 3 on the strength of one of rodgers best overall games of the season if cincy 5 2 wins in week 9 against atlanta the post bye showdown would be for control of the division

news_mentions.headline: Report: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley out for season with turf toe injury
news_mentions.description: The Ravens' quarterback room has received more bad news. Tests revealed that backup QB Tyler Huntley suffered a season-ending turf toe injury, per ESPN.
news_mentions.body_text: the baltimore ravens quarterback room has received more bad news tests revealed that backup qb tyler huntley suffered a season ending turf toe injury espn s adam schefter reported wednesday morning huntley who exited baltimore s week 8 loss to buffalo was already ruled out for thursday s game against the jacksonville jaguars with undrafted rookie joe fagnano set to make the start wednesday s news wipes out any shot huntley had at returning and helping stabilize the position lamar jackson is out indefinitely with a thumb injury the former mvp landing on ir means he will miss at least four weeks and could miss the rest of the season on a short week the ravens had little choice but to turn to fagnano the club added kedon slovis to the active roster and austin reed to the practice squad this week but neither would be ready in such short order the question is whether baltimore makes a move for an established qb in an attempt to buoy its season after slipping to 4 4 after three straight losses recently demoted arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett could be one candidate if the ravens are willing to shell out any draft assets to solve their quarterback quandary before the season spirals completely away

news_mentions.headline: Ravens to start undrafted rookie QB Joe Fagnano vs. Jaguars on Thursday
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter announced on Tuesday that undrafted rookie QB Joe Fagnano will start Thursday night's game against the Jaguars.
news_mentions.body_text: the baltimore ravens will start an undrafted rookie at quarterback against the 5 2 jacksonville jaguars head coach jesse minter announced on tuesday that joe fagnano will start thursday night s game against the jaguars fagnano will become the second undrafted rookie qb in ravens history to start a game joining anthony brown in 2022 with lamar jackson injuring his right thumb just one snap into his return this past sunday and tyler huntley suffering a toe injury baltimore had little choice but to turn to fagnano on a short week the rookie took over for the bulk of sunday s loss to the buffalo bills he went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception the ravens added kedon slovis to their active roster and austin reed to the practice squad this week perhaps if they played sunday baltimore could have turned to slovis or imported another veteran but playing thursday virtually guaranteed fagnano who is also dealing with an ankle issue would get the start against a good jags squad fagnano was listed as limited in the team s monday practice estimation was upgraded to a full participant on tuesday with fagnano making his first start on a short week expect a boatload of derrick henry early against a jaguars run defense that just lost stout defensive tackle davon hamilton for the season the undrafted rookie was an excellent story when he made the initial 53 man roster out of camp at the time the ravens couldn t have envisioned they d need him to keep their season alive now it s fagnano versus one of the best teams in the afc as baltimore 4 4 tries to snap a three game losing streak no pressure kid

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals place rookie Jeremiyah Love on IR due to high ankle sprain
news_mentions.description: The Arizona Cardinals are placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: jeremiyah love s rookie season has taken another turn for the worse the arizona cardinals have placed the running back on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain that is expected to knock him out for four to five weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on tuesday the no 3 overall pick had previously dealt with a different ankle sprain head coach mike lafleur said monday the cardinals also announced on tuesday that wide receiver kendrick bourne has been placed on ir love went down in the first quarter of sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and did not return he d missed the previous two contests due to injury in six games the first rounder has generated 268 yards on 76 carries with one touchdown averaging 3 4 yards per tote the bulk of his production came in a 21 carry 90 yard performance in a week 3 loss to san francisco the cardinals used a top three pick on love in april believing he could add a dynamic game changing weapon to the backfield a la bijan robinson in atlanta or jahmyr gibbs in detroit love hasn t been healthy enough for most of the season to know for sure if he has that kind of sustainable upside arizona gave love a significant workload in his first preseason action handing it off 11 times and tossing him three passes the belief at the time was that getting reps early would prepare love for the regular season gauntlet instead he left that game with a nicked up ankle he hasn t seemed right since perhaps shutting the rb down for at least four games will allow him to come back fully healthy for the season s stretch run in the meantime tyler allgeier who sparked the cardinals comeback win over the cowboys figures to get the bulk of the totes fellow back bam knight currently is in the league s concussion protocol and veteran james conner remains on injured reserve evan hull is currently the healthy backup option for allgeier

news_mentions.headline: Aaron Glenn says improving Jets 'only thing I think about' amid 2-6 start
news_mentions.description: Head coach Aaron Glenn says improving the Jets is "the only thing I think about" amid the team's 2-6 start to the season.
news_mentions.body_text: new york jets head coach aaron glenn faced questions monday about whether he s concerned about his job security one day after the team fell to 2 6 the jets blew a nine point second half lead at home on sunday falling 38 33 to the rebuilding las vegas raiders it marked gang green s third straight loss and their second three game losing streak of the season with so much to clean up glenn said he doesn t have time to consider whether his job is in jeopardy there s so much that i think about when it comes to us improving each week that it doesn t really come across my mind to be honest with you glenn told reporters on monday i understand how this league is i understand about what this business is about but my first job each week is improving this team and that s the only thing that i think about glenn s message continues to focus on what s in front of the jets absolutely i mean that s what this is glenn said it s a bottom line business and we have to win but we still have nine games left so we still have an opportunity to win nine games glenn s defense collapsed on sunday allowing kirk cousins to light it up through the air cousins became the sixth qb since 1950 age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes and a rushing touchdown in a game joining tom brady five times hall of famer drew brees three times vinny testaverde josh mccown and jon kitna per nfl research the jets offense put up enough points to defeat the raiders even if two stalled red zone drives early stung glenn s defense was the culprit we were not successful in the passing game glenn said a lot of that has to do with us number one making plays two me putting them in position and three not allowing these third down penalties the jets imported a slew of veteran defenders to help fix the defense this offseason it hasn t worked so far and if glenn s defense continues to deteriorate things could get even uglier i m disappointed to be here at 2 6 no doubt receiver garrett wilson said per the new york daily news that s not the goal at the end of the day i take a lot of pride in it each week in improving the record but just playing good football for the jets name for the wilson name so it s deep nothing changes we are trying to go 9 0 to finish whatever it may be a 9 0 finish or something close might be what s needed for glenn to change the storyline when it comes to his future

news_mentions.headline: Jeffery Simmons makes 'profound' impact in first game with Bears
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears' acquisition of Jeffery Simmons immediately paid off with the defensive tackle spearheading a crew that destroyed the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: how s that for immediate impact the chicago bears trade for defensive tackle jeffery simmons paid instant dividends in monday night s 34 17 road shellacking of the defending super bowl champion seattle seahawks his impact was profound coach ben johnson said of simmons per the team s official website the man sporting the bright orange long sleeves was impossible to miss simmons stuffed the stat sheet in his first game with the bears netting a sack six tackles two tackles for loss a pass defended and a quarterback pressure we re always watching the jumbotron but we were really watching the jumbotron receiver kalif raymond quipped watching him play watching the impact he has i mean he has a whole other element simmons arrival allows coordinator dennis allen to play his defense differently instead of blitzing additional rushers to get one on one matchups the new addition does that for him simmons was the only bears defensive lineman to record double digit double teams 13 on monday night per next gen stats that presence opened up the rest of the crew it s not a coincidence that montez sweat had his best game with his former mississippi state teammate in the lineup sweat had a sack three qb pressures and a tackle for loss in the win i definitely got my opportunities sweat said i definitely got some 1 on 1s i was looking forward to taking advantage of that and i m looking forward to doing that the rest of the year simmons has definitely upped his game and his iq he s always had a real love for the game and that affects you across the whole line and the whole team despite just arriving simmons played a full slate of snaps 48 of 56 per ngs when the big man was on the field chicago allowed just 3 0 yards per play on a 25 0 success rate while recording five tackles for loss on the eight plays simmons was off the field the bears allowed 13 3 yards per play a 62 5 success rate and a 37 5 explosive play rate that s a quantitative difference i kept telling myself it s just football go out there and be me play by play just stay in the moment simmons said that s always my goal just embrace the moment that s what happened tonight it was like a lift off my shoulders once i ran out there thank god they got the ball first as well to be able to run out there and get my first snaps as a chicago bear it was a lot of emotions i m grateful to be here and today was a great start if simmons play keeps up the hefty cost to acquire him won t seem so weighty down the road simmons has been a game wrecker for years unfortunately too few people got to see that in action over the past seven plus seasons in tennessee in chicago the man in neon orange will be hard to miss

news_mentions.headline: Bears-Seahawks on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Chicago's 34-17 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down Chicago's win on Monday night over the reigning Super Bowl champion, Seattle.
news_mentions.body_text: chicago makes another statement as contenders the bears beat the reigning afc champion last week at home as an encore they went ahead and took down the reigning super bowl champions on the road at lumen field one of the most formidable stadiums in the league for visiting teams the latter victory was perhaps their most impressive of the season chicago led wire to wire immediately quieting seattle s home crowd by forcing a three and out and following it up with an 80 yard touchdown march that took 17 plays the most against seattle on a td drive in 10 years per nfl research caleb williams threw for 247 yards against a defense that had been allowing 144 4 passing yards per game with no previous signal caller going over 176 yards the bears offense put up 363 yards total another high allowed by the seahawks who are one of three teams in the past 20 seasons to allow 301 or fewer yards in each of their first seven games chicago s defense was swarming sacking sam darnold three times picking him off once and holding seattle to 252 total yards only 1 more than the seahawks season low and the special teams that unit blocked a critical field goal in the first minute of the fourth quarter when the game was still close the bears set the tone early responded when necessary and outlasted the champs for what turned out to be a comfortable margin of victory who would deny them as contenders at this point seahawks aren t playing complementary football seattle s defense fought about as courageously as a unit could while giving up 34 points for much of the night as the seahawks offense floundered the defense kept them in it holding the bears to six points over their last five first half possessions after the odyssey that was chicago s opening td drive the defense also forced a three and out right after halftime which the offense rudely paid back with its fourth three and out of the game in the end the dark side d wore down at fault for the points allowed but hardly the reason the seahawks lost sam darnold and co were completely outmatched they went one of 11 on third down a symptom of offensive coordinator brian fleury s confounding plan to run or throw short on early downs despite it constantly resulting in playing behind the sticks darnold looked jumpy throughout while completing only half of his passes going 17 of 34 for 188 yards two touchdowns and an interception and the run game continually ran into a brick wall the seahawks are now 1 2 in their last three games during which they ve averaged 12 3 points per game while giving up a respectable 22 7 points per game they went 1 2 in their three games before that as well although during that stretch it was the defense that momentarily lost its way from week 3 5 the seahawks averaged 30 points per game but allowed 29 3 per outing the unevenness has resulted in a 4 4 record tied with the rams in the middle of the nfc west and only one game ahead of the cellar dwelling cardinals the two sides must find their stride simultaneously moving forward to have any hope of sustaining a winning streak simmons effect the immediacy with which jeffery simmons made an impact on monday night s game was impressive traded from a one win team to the reigning nfc north champions on thursday and three days later playing his first prime time game in three years the perennial pro bowler put on a menacing performance from the start his most showy display of dominance came on his fourth snap as a bear simmons swam past grey zabel with ease burst into the backfield and flung sam darnold to the ground for a sack with ferocity it was a massive play unfortunately minimized by grady jarrett committing a face mask penalty after the whistle but it still provided an early sign of what could be for the bears who finally have a difference maker on the interior and stayed charged up to force a punt three plays later anyway simmons logged three tackles a qb pressure and the sack in his first 10 snaps and by game s end had a team leading six tackles a sack a qb hit a pass deflection and two tackles for loss chicago s defense had been playing well this year ranking ninth in both points and yards allowed entering week 8 but the unit rendered seattle hopeless for large swaths of monday night instead of being overwhelmed by the 12s on the road the bears d instead fed off its own contagious atmosphere it s all thanks to the man in the orange sleeves an alteration from the red he rocked with the titans for all those years prior jsn and who else you would think the returns of zach charbonnet and jadarian price plus the addition of guard quenton nelson would provide a big boost to seattle s running game sadly for the seahawks that was far from the case price managed a meager 29 yards on 10 carries while charbonnet had six carries for 23 yards seattle s 81 rushing yards were its second lowest on the season and even reaching that total seemed an arduous task with the bears regularly taking away would be lanes and the running backs too often opting to bail out to try to find space laterally when it came to passing jaxon smith njigba was essentially the entire operation he accounted for 92 of the team s 94 passing yards by halftime with four catches to the rest of the team s three he made tyrique stevenson look downright foolish on his second quarter touchdown leaving the safety in the dust by faking in for a slant before cutting upfield and streaking down the sideline all alone but when the bears finally silenced him over the next two quarters seattle s already quiet supporting cast didn t get any louder tory horton finished with three catches for 26 yards aj barner contributed 23 yards on two snags price charbonnet and cooper kupp each failed to hit double digits in receiving yards and they combined for six catches smith njigba is an all world receiver but where in the world is the other production coming from in this offense williams spreads the wealth just as they did last week the bears opened up with a heightened focus on luther burden the second year wideout collected four catches for 23 yards and a touchdown on chicago s opening drive he led the team in receptions six and yards 53 at halftime and again just like last week he hardly contributed to the stat sheet in the second half adding only one more catch for 3 yards while rome odunze began heating up to end with 87 yards on four catches colston loveland who tied burden for the team lead with nine targets catching seven of them for 65 yards enjoyed the most balanced game in terms of catching williams eye he did fumble however gifting the seahawks a short field to eventually make it a three point game in the final frame yet another playmaker showed up as part of chicago s response to the gaffe after a delay of game penalty fortuitously saved the bears from having a run blown up on third and 4 kalif raymond took his turn catching a backward pass from williams on the ensuing third and 9 and splitting a crowd of seahawks to take the 39 yard run down to seattle s 5 d 39 andre swift who averaged only 2 6 yards per carry on 27 attempts punched it in from there his second of a hat trick of rushing touchdowns on the night the bears offense is the complete opposite of seattle s jsn centric attack everyone can do damage it s impossible to predict who is going to hurt you and that s what makes it so dangerous next gen stats insight for bears seahawks via nfl pro caleb williams completed 10 of his 15 play action pass attempts 66 7 for 109 yards and one touchdown against the seahawks his 47 2 play action rate is his highest this season and the fourth highest by a quarterback this season minimum 25 attempts nfl research the bears became the first team in nfl history to beat both super bowl participants from the previous season in back to back prime time games

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals name Gardner Minshew starting quarterback; rookie Carson Beck to be backup
news_mentions.description: Gardner Minshew will be Arizona's starter "moving forward," coach Mike LaFleur announced Monday, while rookie Carson Beck will be his backup, starting this Sunday against the Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: the cardinals are shuffling the deck at quarterback entering the back half of the season gardner minshew will be arizona s starter moving forward coach mike lafleur announced monday while rookie carson beck will be his backup starting in week 9 against the seahawks minshew replaces jacoby brissett who started arizona s first eight games but now slides into an emergency third qb role that s not easy lafleur said of demoting brissett who has led the cards to a 3 5 record it s not a fun phone call there s no book for that obviously there s a human element to it i have a lot of respect for jacoby the person i have a lot of respect for jacoby the player like i told you guys yesterday this was not all on him this was collective starting with me but the position that those guys sign up for we know the deal we needed a spark and obvious gardner gave us one minshew provided the spark in the third quarter of sunday s game against the cowboys when he entered for a benched brissett with arizona down 17 3 what followed was a mad cap comeback with minshew completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns leading five scoring drives including the game winning march in overtime to win 33 30 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven interceptions this season and was 10 of 23 passing for 119 yards and an int on sunday at the time of his benching they very well may have been his last snaps in arizona the journeyman s benching raises the question of whether he will be on the trade block ahead of the nov 10 deadline with qb injuries and questions mounting around the league a third string brissett 33 is an attractive trade target asked whether brissett could be on his way out of town lafleur said monday he was only focused on the upcoming week he s fully a part of this team lafleur said excited to see him still be the teammate i know he is minshew is slated to make his first start for arizona the 30 year old mustachioed man has started 47 games 64 games played for five nfl franchises since being selected by the jaguars in the sixth round of the 2019 draft minshew s appearance in week 8 was his first of the season he last started a game for kansas city in week 16 of last year brissett s demotion springboards beck the no 65 overall pick in the 2026 nfl draft into the qb2 role lafleur said the rookie is week to week with a back injury but is ready to step into the backup position i just think that s the right thing to do lafleur explained to continue his development in terms of getting more reps with the scout team and all that entering monday night football the cardinals rank 18th in passing yards per game 223 8 but 29th in pass yards per play 5 44 at 3 5 they have overperformed in the treacherous nfc west and are just one game back of the third place rams whom they face in week 10 whether brissett is on the roster by then is now a question as arizona looks to minshew as the answer under center

news_mentions.headline: Colts' Shane Steichen to 'evaluate everything, every position' after embarrassing loss in Jacksonville
news_mentions.description: The Indianapolis Colts lost their fourth straight game, this one in embarrassing fashion in a 42-7 loss in Jacksonville.
news_mentions.body_text: it s getting dark early in indianapolis the colts suffered another embarrassing loss on sunday getting their doors blown off 42 7 by rival jacksonville already amid a teardown it s the type of loss that puts more jobs in question coach shane steichen sits in the crosshairs after indy already parted ways with general manager chris ballard and traded away quenton nelson and deforest buckner it s one thing to be 2 6 it s a different matter to get walloped by a rival in disheartening fashion for a fourth straight loss it wasn t good enough flat out wasn t good enough steichen said via the indianapolis star we got outcoached we got outplayed and we ve got to freaking learn from our mistakes in a hurry the effort and the energy has to be there every week if not you re going to get beat like that the colts played like a team whose players know there is no coming back this season missed tackles botched offensive plays leading to turnovers ineffective quarterback play questionable play calls everything was a mess those issues fall squarely on steichen clearly i ve got to do a better job plain and simple steichen said it starts with me as the head coach i ve got to do a better job to get these guys ready to go that wasn t it today the question is how much longer steichen is the head coach clearly he couldn t get his players ready for a division opponent after the week of trades might indy be better served severing ties now than waiting until the new year i m focused on getting better steichen said that s what i m focused on right now beyond steichen s future the colts have several big questions between now and next week jonathan taylorcould be traded the rb had a big 19 yard run out of the gate on sunday but did little else the rest of the way earning 23 rushing yards on eight carries and a fumble on a botched trick play the colts may not have wanted to put taylor in harm s way with the trade deadline looming but once indy was down big there was little point in putting more tread on his tires regardless of how things play out then there is daniel jones who has struggled mightily this season on sunday he completed 19 of 28 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions before being sat in the blowout jones play has sunk like a rock this season he has missed passes and gets rattled any time there is pressure he looks like the jones who earned his ticket out of new york in 2024 his dismal play has jump started questions about whether the colts should give anthony richardson a shot i m going to evaluate everything every position going forward steichen said when asked if jones would remain his team s starting quarterback that evaluation should start with how he prepares his team to play

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top
