news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Cardinals to trade QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens
material_news_signals.description: The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Wednesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: sometimes nfl teams do make the obvious moves the baltimore ravens are finalizing a trade for arizona cardinals quarterback jacoby brissett nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday the deal is expected to be completed over the weekend terms of the swap were not reported and cardinals head coach mike lafleur declined to go into details or confirm the deal out of respect for the process i ll let the process play out with that said lafleur via the cardinals website s darren urban before adding he expected it all to play out in the next few days brissett was benched during sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and demoted to third string on monday the benching coupled with the ravens glaring need at quarterback after losing lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury this week made a swap all too obvious not only was the need clear but brissett will reunite with ravens qb coach israel woolfolk with whom he worked last season in arizona and in cleveland in 2022 that familiarity will help the veteran qb to jump right into the fray it made sense for arizona to move on from brissett after naming gardner minshew the starter and carson beck the backup eventually beck should get some starting reps by trading brissett the cards also shed salary after reworking the qb s deal this offseason the ravens won t acquire brissett before thursday s game against jacksonville but he s expected to start when baltimore faces the los angeles chargers in week 10 on monday night football undrafted rookie joe fagnano will start on thursday night football versus the jags the ravens will be brissett s seventh franchise and mark his seventh different team in seven years the journeyman knows how to pick up an offense and can run the operation in arizona some off target throws began to hurt the offense and he didn t seem the best fit in mike lafleur s scheme but he s a professional who can at least give the ravens an operational distributor losers of three straight heading into thursday night the ravens hope brissett s arrival can help keep them afloat in a tough playoff race baltimore currently sits last in the division at 4 4 and 10th in the afc

material_news_signals.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will miss Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals due to a quad injury, head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters on Wednesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the seahawks recent offensive struggles look like they could worsen in week 9 quarterback sam darnold will not play in seattle s game against the arizona cardinals on sunday due to a quadriceps injury suffered late in monday night s loss to the chicago bears coach mike macdonald announced wednesday macdonald added that the plan is for drew lock who is dealing with an elbow injury to start in place of darnold sam injured his quad at the end of the game so sam s going to be out this week macdonald said it s going to be week to week for sam he s not going to go on injured reserve the news leads the seahawks to a place that has become familiar in 2026 darnold injured his glute during the first possession of seattle s season opening win over new england forcing lock into action for the rest of that contest and the ensuing game darnold missed the ensuing week and lock completed 19 of 26 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns in a lopsided win over the cardinals in arizona lock s health status isn t entirely guaranteed either the quarterback is dealing with an elbow injury and was listed as the emergency third quarterback in week 8 with jalen milroe dressing as darnold s backup with darnold once again on the mend lock will have to play through whatever elbow discomfort remains as the seahawks attempt to improve their 4 4 record against a cardinals team that has won two of the last three games and is also rolling out a new starter in gardner minshew

material_news_signals.headline: Cardinals name Gardner Minshew starting quarterback; rookie Carson Beck to be backup
material_news_signals.description: Gardner Minshew will be Arizona's starter "moving forward," coach Mike LaFleur announced Monday, while rookie Carson Beck will be his backup, starting this Sunday against the Seahawks.
material_news_signals.body_text: the cardinals are shuffling the deck at quarterback entering the back half of the season gardner minshew will be arizona s starter moving forward coach mike lafleur announced monday while rookie carson beck will be his backup starting in week 9 against the seahawks minshew replaces jacoby brissett who started arizona s first eight games but now slides into an emergency third qb role that s not easy lafleur said of demoting brissett who has led the cards to a 3 5 record it s not a fun phone call there s no book for that obviously there s a human element to it i have a lot of respect for jacoby the person i have a lot of respect for jacoby the player like i told you guys yesterday this was not all on him this was collective starting with me but the position that those guys sign up for we know the deal we needed a spark and obvious gardner gave us one minshew provided the spark in the third quarter of sunday s game against the cowboys when he entered for a benched brissett with arizona down 17 3 what followed was a mad cap comeback with minshew completing 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns leading five scoring drives including the game winning march in overtime to win 33 30 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven interceptions this season and was 10 of 23 passing for 119 yards and an int on sunday at the time of his benching they very well may have been his last snaps in arizona the journeyman s benching raises the question of whether he will be on the trade block ahead of the nov 10 deadline with qb injuries and questions mounting around the league a third string brissett 33 is an attractive trade target asked whether brissett could be on his way out of town lafleur said monday he was only focused on the upcoming week he s fully a part of this team lafleur said excited to see him still be the teammate i know he is minshew is slated to make his first start for arizona the 30 year old mustachioed man has started 47 games 64 games played for five nfl franchises since being selected by the jaguars in the sixth round of the 2019 draft minshew s appearance in week 8 was his first of the season he last started a game for kansas city in week 16 of last year brissett s demotion springboards beck the no 65 overall pick in the 2026 nfl draft into the qb2 role lafleur said the rookie is week to week with a back injury but is ready to step into the backup position i just think that s the right thing to do lafleur explained to continue his development in terms of getting more reps with the scout team and all that entering monday night football the cardinals rank 18th in passing yards per game 223 8 but 29th in pass yards per play 5 44 at 3 5 they have overperformed in the treacherous nfc west and are just one game back of the third place rams whom they face in week 10 whether brissett is on the roster by then is now a question as arizona looks to minshew as the answer under center

news_mentions.headline: Cardinals place rookie Jeremiyah Love on IR due to high ankle sprain
news_mentions.description: The Arizona Cardinals are placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: jeremiyah love s rookie season has taken another turn for the worse the arizona cardinals have placed the running back on injured reserve due to a high ankle sprain that is expected to knock him out for four to five weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on tuesday the no 3 overall pick had previously dealt with a different ankle sprain head coach mike lafleur said monday the cardinals also announced on tuesday that wide receiver kendrick bourne has been placed on ir love went down in the first quarter of sunday s comeback win over the dallas cowboys and did not return he d missed the previous two contests due to injury in six games the first rounder has generated 268 yards on 76 carries with one touchdown averaging 3 4 yards per tote the bulk of his production came in a 21 carry 90 yard performance in a week 3 loss to san francisco the cardinals used a top three pick on love in april believing he could add a dynamic game changing weapon to the backfield a la bijan robinson in atlanta or jahmyr gibbs in detroit love hasn t been healthy enough for most of the season to know for sure if he has that kind of sustainable upside arizona gave love a significant workload in his first preseason action handing it off 11 times and tossing him three passes the belief at the time was that getting reps early would prepare love for the regular season gauntlet instead he left that game with a nicked up ankle he hasn t seemed right since perhaps shutting the rb down for at least four games will allow him to come back fully healthy for the season s stretch run in the meantime tyler allgeier who sparked the cardinals comeback win over the cowboys figures to get the bulk of the totes fellow back bam knight currently is in the league s concussion protocol and veteran james conner remains on injured reserve evan hull is currently the healthy backup option for allgeier

news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the San Francisco 49ers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the san francisco 49ers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location sap performance facility santa clara california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs denver broncos 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at las vegas raiders 4 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs los angeles chargers 8 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note san francisco doesn t face a team that made the 2024 playoffs in the final eight weeks of the upcoming season nfl research what you need to know 1 after a four year sojourn in jersey as the new york jets head coach robert saleh has returned to the bay as defensive coordinator but his house isn t as he left it the 49ers were fifth in yards allowed and 17th in points in 2020 saleh s last with the squad in 2024 they were still eighth in yards but an awful 29th in points given up san francisco underwent myriad roster changes with plenty of departures on the defensive side dre greenlaw talanoa hufanga and charvarius ward among them the cupboard is hardly bare though as saleh can rely on dominant mainstays nick bosa and fred warner among the big questions to be answered this summer is how his ex jets pass rusher bryce huff acclimates out west after a trying 2024 with the philadelphia eagles and how fast no 11 overall pick mykel williams gets going there are plenty more quandaries for saleh to address though williams is likely to be among three rookie starters along with defensive tackle alfred collins and linebacker nick martin and the 49ers produced just 37 sacks a season ago tied for 23rd in the nfl saleh s got plenty of reconstruction at hand amid his return 2 unlike last summer christian mccaffrey is set for training camp and set to be all systems go originally thought to be precautionary mccaffrey missed camp last year with an achilles and calf injury that extended to him missing the first eight games of the season after finally getting back on the field mccaffrey s campaign concluded with a pcl injury in total he played only four games during a disastrous 2024 season cmc has proclaimed himself healthy from his pcl and had no restrictions during offseason workouts his health will remain a concern though it s a given following the third season in his eight year career in which he played seven games or less due to injury the coming weeks will also be worth seeing if mccaffrey 29 resembles his 2023 rushing champion self since he was traded from the panthers whom he s slated to face for the first time in week 12 to the 49ers mccaffrey has propelled san francisco to a 23 8 record when he s on the field the niners are 8 12 without him plain and simple mccaffrey is one of the nfl s elite when he s healthful and so are the 49ers 3 finally the 49ers were in line for a drama less training camp then reports surfaced that wide receiver jauan jennings was disenchanted with his contract a two year 15 39 million pact signed in the spring of 2024 brock purdy george kittle and fred warner each worked out lengthy and lucrative new deals already in a stark contrast from past offseasons when brandon aiyuk and trent williams 2024 nick bosa 2023 and deebo samuel 2022 had dilemmas dominate summer headlines just how large jennings contract dismay looms over camp remains to be seen regardless it illuminates an already existing concern for the 49ers their wide receiver corps samuel was one of plenty notable departures for the team the wideback s trade to washington coupled with aiyuk s recovery from a 2024 knee injury put the position in question jennings stepped up and into the wr1 role last season and will likely get tabbed as such again but there s now a wrinkle to those best laid plans 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall has a big camp ahead and a larger role to take after that ex los angeles ram demarcus robinson second year wideout jacob cowing and rookies jordan watkins and junior bergen will be vying to make contributions

news_mentions.description: How far does Dak Prescott slip in Nick Shook's QB rankings after the Cowboys' most recent collapse? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 8 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen and the bills had a rough start against the ravens but the extra possessions afforded by a lifeless baltimore offense gave them plenty of time to figure things out congratulations are in order for allen who passed hall of famer jim kelly on the all time bills passing touchdowns list allen retains the top spot in my rankings because he consistently produces at an elite level caleb williams continues to execute ben johnson s offense at a high rate of excellence appearing completely comfortable and capable of accomplishing whatever madness his coach draws up for the offense monday night s win over the seahawks included a direct snap to d andre swift and jet toss to williams who calmly received the toss turned and fired a strike to rome odunze as if they d done it 1 000 times before i ll continue to say it if williams keeps this up he ll be in the mvp race and the bears will be in the super bowl discussion joe burrow lit up tennessee for 462 passing yards and six total touchdowns but he threw three interceptions that gave the titans additional chances to pull off the upset in fact burrow was tasked with leading the bengals back from a fourth quarter deficit before finishing off the win in overtime you ll take the bad with the good when your quarterback is propelling such an explosive offense i suppose detroit s win over minnesota carries more weight than the average victory because of the defense the lions defeated and the fashion in which they did it jared goff was central to the fourth quarter comeback effort leading an excellent go ahead touchdown drive against an elite opponent they keep finding ways to deliver in the clutch thanks in part to goff and jahmyr gibbs of course brock purdy was uncharacteristically sloppy with the football in his most recent outing which finished with san francisco s first loss of 2026 if he can get mike evans back soon i expect those mistakes to decrease like purdy c j stroud spent the week resting thanks to the bye he s been better than his team s 2 5 record suggests but he ll need to maintain his level of performance to keep his place in tier 1 and give the texans a chance of climbing out of the hole they ve dug for themselves next gen stats insights via nfl pro joe burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown against tennessee his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season burrow was also effective when the titans blitzed 30 2 third highest in a game by the titans this season completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards three touchdowns and an interception tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career tier 2 trevor lawrence shredded the colts throwing for 210 yards and three touchdowns on just 14 attempts that s the kind of bounce back game he needed after the jaguars disappointing week 6 loss he s largely been consistent and i expect nothing less going forward drake maye and the patriots woke up in the second half of their win over the dolphins complete with maye taking a speed option keeper for a rushing score he s so fun to watch especially when he breaks out of early game struggles jordan love s deep shots to matthew golden and christian watson are becoming part of our weekly football viewing ritual and they ve never looked prettier love has cut down on mistakes and is carrying the offense which still lacks a running game like love kirk cousins is largely carrying his offense i m not sure what it means for his future but we can quell those calls for fernando mendoza for a bit cousins continues to be the reason the raiders can score in bunches patrick mahomes was on his game during a key second half stretch of sunday s loss to denver converting crucial third downs to sustain a touchdown drive that was especially impressive when considering kenneth walker was a minimal factor for a second straight week kansas city s inability to convert in a goal to go situation with the game on the line was disheartening but i m still encouraged by how mahomes bounced back after a dreadful week 7 showing next gen stats insights via nfl pro jordan love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and an interception against the panthers last week love completed 23 of 25 passes thrown in under 2 5 seconds for 177 yards and two touchdowns the most quick completions by any quarterback in a game this season and the most of his career previous high 19 in week 7 of 2024 tier 3 dak prescott played a part in dallas disintegration on sunday he s being asked to carry an offense that too often can t count on legitimate contributions from the running game jerry jones said this week that george pickens should be seeing more targets so have fun disproportionately looking pickens way this week dak i m not banking on it fixing things geno smith has played much better than the jets 2 6 record suggests and i won t dock him for his late interception thrown out of desperation against the raiders he s largely done enough to keep new york competitive but his successes will likely be lost in the greater picture unless of course one chooses to closely examine the weekly performances of adonai mitchell or omar cooper the rams have a problem with remarkably flat starts they re finding ways to get the job done but matthew stafford posted a pedestrian stat line in los angeles second straight win 17 of 25 for 157 yards td int they re far from the offense they need to be and that includes stafford who hasn t looked all that comfortable in sean mcvay s offense for most of the season yes i ll go out on a limb and propel cam ward up the index aggressively after the best performance of his career time will tell whether it was a sign of things to come but on sunday ward looked the part of a former no 1 overall pick he was excellent composed sharp and convicted in his decision making pushing the titans close to a huge upset before a brutal sack knocked them well out of field goal range late in the fourth quarter titans fans should feel encouraged by what they saw from ward though and acknowledge it s another building block laid along the young signal caller s nfl journey aaron rodgers didn t need to do much for the steelers in their win over the browns but he remains the savvy veteran who can quickly identify a weakness in a defensive coverage and exploit it i m still curious to see what happens if the steelers genuinely need him to go win a game for them though next gen stats insights via nfl pro cam ward completed 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against cincinnati the bengals used man coverage on 44 7 of their coverage snaps their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage his most completions yards and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career tier 4 sam darnold still hasn t found a comfortable place in an offense that cannot run the ball and relies disproportionately on jaxon smith njigba it works out sometimes smith njigba s slant and go produced a desperately needed touchdown for the seahawks before halftime against the bears but unless darnold morphs into a superhero quarterback he s going to continue to show some warts it s just who he is editor s update darnold has been ruled out for week 9 with a quad injury he suffered in monday night s game jayden daniels output isn t astronomical by any means but he does add an element of unpredictability that allows the commanders to sustain a competitive offensive attack he s also good for a few deep strikes per game even without terry mclaurin bryce young bounced back respectably after a nightmarish week 7 outing throwing the panthers to a first half lead and flirting with a fourth quarter comeback against the packers he ll need better protection and might have to adjust his process a bit to move closer toward the standout he was early in the season box score scanners will point to another 300 yard outing for deshaun watson and wonder how he s landed among the likes of tyler shough and j j mccarthy they ll point to his eight sacks in sunday s loss and blame his offensive line what they ll fail to recognize is how watson is running himself into pressure with unnecessarily elongated deep drops out of shotgun how his tendency to hold onto the ball becomes a problem against aggressive pass rushes and how his early fumble put the browns at a disadvantage in a hostile setting in pittsburgh is it time to press the panic button no but watson s ceiling is still pretty visible and sunday served as a reminder of it bo nix is still incredibly conservative with his decisions but to his credit he did try to push the ball downfield a bit against the chiefs it s no surprise his most productive throws were still at or behind the line of scrimmage but hey at least he isn t hurting his team with turnovers malik willis wasn t quite as good as he was in week 7 but he still piloted the dolphins to a 13 3 halftime lead against the patriots the second half however reminded us of how far this entire dolphins team still has to go willis included next gen stats insights via nfl pro jayden daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the commanders win over the eagles more than two thirds of that yardage came against man coverage where he completed 8 of 13 passes for a career high 148 yards and a touchdown daniels was successful generating chunk plays completing all three of his deep attempts 20 air yards for 104 yards his most in a game since week 8 of the 2024 season against the bears he added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles tier 5 well i know kyler murray can make one throw the seam ball to t j hockenson it produced two big gains and a touchdown in another low scoring affair for the vikings who desperately need some balance if only to buy murray time to throw they re still far from reaching the ideal state with murray under center but they ve already made their bed at this point unless kevin o connell suddenly becomes intrigued by a quarterback elsewhere or gulp decides he d rather play carson wentz i hate to rank michael penix so low but i cannot excuse the four interceptions he threw on sunday regardless of the monsoon in which the falcons and bucs were playing it s clear the weather created difficult conditions that affected penix s performance but the gulf between penix s good which is remarkably good and bad is strikingly wide that means his ranking will remain volatile until he can prove he can be a consistent quarterback what is there to say about lamar jackson he threw one pass on sunday and suffered a thumb injury on that throw which might end his season after he d just missed three games due to an ankle injury worst of all his replacement is likely to land even lower on the index in future weeks in baker mayfield s two games since returning from a thumb injury he has completed 7 of 14 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown the buccaneers are 2 0 in those games he didn t complete a pass against the falcons though a ted hurst drop robbed him of a touchdown i remain curious to see if he can actually get back to his old ways because his current style of play cannot continue to produce wins next gen stats insights via nfl pro kyler murray threw for 210 yards two touchdowns and one interception in the vikings loss to the lions murray averaged 11 2 air yards per attempt his second highest mark in a game trailing only a week 3 of 2024 matchup against the lions 11 6 murray targeted downfield 10 air yards on 44 8 of his attempts his second highest rate as a viking on downfield attempts murray threw for a season high 115 yards despite only completing 4 of 13 attempts 30 8 his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 minimum 10 downfield attempts tier 6 i believe we ve seen the last of jacoby brissett in a game for the cardinals and frankly his benching was more revelatory than i anticipated his struggles i thought were a product of a bad offense but when gardner minshew replaced him against the cowboys and completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns i quickly learned brissett was part of the problem i m interested to see if another team tries to work a trade for him before the deadline otherwise he ll spend the rest of the season in the shadows to which he s been banished by mike lafleur editor s update the cardinals and ravens are finalizing a trade that will send brissett to baltimore per nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter tanner mckee looks more comfortable than he did last year but his productivity and viability as a starter hasn t yet lasted the full length of a game he and the eagles were incredibly ineffective in the second half of sunday night s loss which i fear is a precursor of more struggles to come editor s update the eagles are reportedly benching mckee in favor of joe milton for week 9 daniel jones continues to struggle with turnovers in an offense that features two players jonathan taylor and josh downs who could be traded soon the colts are in full teardown mode and jones isn t giving them many reasons to continue playing him even with their lack of confidence in anthony richardson we re left to wonder whether he might get benched or if he too could be on the move justin herbert threw two more interceptions against the rams the chargers haven t scored a touchdown in ages and the most prominent headline tied to herbert is speculative articles wondering whether he might get traded things are bad for the bolts and herbert remains a central figure in their demise next gen stats insights via nfl pro jacoby brissett was sacked three times and completed just 8 of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers against the cowboys resulting in his lowest completion percentage 40 0 when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in arizona brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards 51 across 17 fewer passes when blitzed 3 overall brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks 55 2 his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season

news_mentions.headline: Aaron Rodgers: Division-leading Steelers 'right where we want to be' despite incomplete win
news_mentions.description: The Steelers enter the bye week at 6-2 after a blowout win over the Browns. Aaron Rodgers knows there is still room for improvement, particularly with the offense.
news_mentions.body_text: the pittsburgh steelers enter the bye week at 6 2 after a blowout win over the cleveland browns avenging an early season loss to the rival quarterback aaron rodgers knows there is still room for improvement particularly with the offense not very complete rodgers said of the win over the browns via the team s official website defense played excellent special teams did fine but offense should have had a lot more points there were a couple opportunities we didn t execute down there on the goal line the steelers racked up 361 yards but also went 4 of 11 on third downs and kicked two field goals in the red zone rodgers knows they ll need to finish better to get where they want to go we d like to play our best and still win he said we also like to win the defense and rushing attack have keyed the steelers early wins jaylen warren remains among the league s most dynamic runners the shifty back posted 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries against cleveland including a 51 yard scamper warren has 998 scrimmage yards in 2026 the most by a steelers player through eight games since james conner had 1 085 yards in 2018 warren now has 222 rush yards over the steelers are a run funnel offense with a 42 year old it shouldn t be a surprise that the passing attack is a slog at times rodgers turns back the clock and makes an mvp level throw but overall it control of the division

news_mentions.headline: Week 9 NFL MVP tracker: Can Caleb Williams join Joe Montana in making history?
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at the MVP race heading into Week 9 on the 2026 season. Can Bears QB Caleb Williams do something only accomplished by Joe Montana? Plus, Joe Burrow makes a push into the top five.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams on monday night did what no quarterback has done this season bamboozle the seattle seahawks defense mike macdonald s group entered monday s tilt allowing a league low 144 4 passing yards per game and the stingiest total yards per game 233 9 no qb had hit the 200 yard passing mark against seattle this season the seahawks flustered brock purdy in week 5 into his lowest output 189 yards they flummoxed patrick mahomes 165 and stonewalled running back kenneth walker 36 in week 7 then the bears and williams rolled over them like a ford f 450 super duty blasting through a pinto en route to a 34 17 win williams completed 70 6 of his passes 24 for 34 for 247 yards and a touchdown with no interceptions his third game with at least one touchdown zero interceptions and a 70 or higher completion percentage this season tied for most in the nfl per nfl research williams is the first qb with such a game against the seahawks since baker mayfield in week 5 2025 jordan love and jared goff both in 2024 are the only other qbs with such a game against seattle since macdonald became the coach in 2024 mastermind ben johnson deserves credit for a chicago offense that keeps defenses off kilter the bears offensive line is as strong as any in the league the running backs keep yards churning and the wide receivers create space and gobble up yards after the catch but it all funnels through williams the qb was sublime on monday night in the face of the nfl s top defense in a hostile road environment at lumen field there were a few hiccups including some errant throws and three three and outs but overall williams showed he is in complete command of johnson s offense that should scare the rest of the nfc i went over williams improvement in year 2 under johnson in last week s column again the qb showed the ability to play within the offense and take the layups when they re there against the seahawks he also feasted off play action with a 40 0 downfield rate off play action and a 23 5 explosive play rate in week 8 his highest of the season per next gen stats what i didn t get into last week was how a hamstring injury that wiped out three games could dash any shot williams has at swiping this year s mvp award history says he s a long shot simply because of those missed games in the post nfl afl merger era since 1970 in non strike shortened seasons only one player has missed three games and still won the nfl mvp award joe montana in 1989 joe cool battled through various injuries that season missing weeks 6 8 and 15 and portions of others every single other mvp missed two or fewer tilts most missed zero here is a complete list of games missed for mvps since 1970 not counting john elway in 1987 and kicker mark moseley in 1982 both strike shortened years 1972 rb larry brown weeks 13 and 14 1989 qb joe montana weeks 6 8 15 1990 qb joe montana week 16 1991 rb thurman thomas week 17 1993 rb emmitt smith weeks 1 and 2 2000 rb marshall faulk weeks 9 and 10 2003 qb steve mcnair weeks 15 and 17 2011 qb aaron rodgers week 18 2019 qb lamar jackson week 18 2021 qb aaron rodgers week 9 2023 qb lamar jackson week 18 that s 11 players out of 53 who missed even a single game during their mvp seasons many of those came at the end of the regular season with players sitting out to prep for a postseason run aside from rodgers positive covid test in 2021 no qb has missed a game due to injury in their mvp season since steve mcnair in 2003 of the five mvps who missed more than a single game three were running backs who racked up enough stats to run away with the award emmitt smith famously sat out the first two games in a contract standoff with the cowboys in 1993 mcnair split the award with peyton manning after missing a couple of late games with calf and ankle injuries the titans qb led the nfl in passer rating and yards per attempt that year mvp voters have leaned toward qbs who rack up stats and stay on the field in 2016 there was some chatter particularly in the northeast as to whether tom brady who missed the first four games of the season due to the deflategate suspension should be considered for the mvp after returning to lead the pats to an 11 1 record with a 28 2 td int ratio brady finished second to the falcons matt ryan with 20 of the vote montana s 1989 season for san francisco sits as the lone outlier despite missing three games montana was the best qb on the best team in the nfl winning the mvp vote in a landslide 62 of 70 votes the 49ers qb overcame the lack of counting stats by leading the nfl in all the efficiency categories 70 2 completion rate a 6 7 td rate 53 7 success rate 9 1 yards per attempt average 270 8 yards per game and set the then record with a 112 4 passer rating when 100 passer ratings were uncommon that s williams path to the mvp be the most efficient passer on the best team the bears qb currently sits second in completion percentage 70 9 fourth in interception rate 0 6 eighth in success rate 49 7 fifth in yards per attempt 8 0 11th in yards per game 253 4 fifth in passer rating 104 6 while ranking second in qbr 78 9 third in epa per dropback 0 22 and fifth in win probability added 117 0 overcoming missed games in terms of the mvp race is extremely difficult missing three is historically daunting williams isn t there yet but if he manhandles other defenses like he did a studly seahawks one on the road he ll have a shot at joining montana as an outlier in the record books now on to the rankings mvp rankings note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 8 edition next in line bears qb caleb williams lions qb jared goff jahmyr gibbs drake maye
